brief.zh: 将频率侧放在长度 2x+1 的循环群上；必须对所有系数避免卷回。
brief.en: Use a single cyclic group of length 2x+1 with no wraparound for any coefficient.

gaps.statement: ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (r m : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ), 0<L → (∀ n ∈ s, L ≤ m n) → (((s.filter (fun n => r n=0)).card : ℝ)*L^2) ≤ ∑ n ∈ s, (r n-m n)^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0041 · 模型均方误差控制零表示目标数引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0041 · Model mean-square error bounds exceptional targets

brief.zh: 只要求模型在选定目标上有下界，允许误差在个别目标很大。
brief.en: Charge a squared lower-bound cost only to targets with zero representations.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0042 · 有限个缩放窗口能覆盖整个二倍区间引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0042 · A fixed finite family of scaled interior windows covers a dyadic block

brief.zh: 给出有限有理覆盖并保留开区间余量，方便随后把 rx 取整。
brief.en: Choose a finite rational cover with strict slack for rounding each scaled window.

gaps.statement: let J := fun x : ℕ => (Finset.range (2*x+1)).filter (fun n => Even n ∧ 13*x≤12*n ∧ 4*n≤5*x); ∃ S : Finset ℚ, (∀ r∈S, 0<r) ∧ ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ x≥X, ∀ n∈Finset.Icc x (2*x), Even n → ∃ r∈S, n∈J ⌊(r:ℝ)*(x:ℝ)⌋₊

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0043 · 取整后中心窗口仍覆盖大规模偶目标引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0043 · Round the rational scales while retaining all large even targets

brief.zh: 利用紧区间上的统一覆盖裕量，吸收每个尺度不足一个单位的误差。 建议先读 L-goldbach-bulk-patch-cover。
brief.en: Use uniform cover slack to absorb less than one unit of scale rounding. Read first: L-goldbach-bulk-patch-cover.

gaps.statement: let J := fun x : ℕ => (Finset.range (2*x+1)).filter (fun n => Even n ∧ 13*x≤12*n ∧ 4*n≤5*x); let B := fun x : ℕ => (Finset.range (x+1)).filter (fun k => x≤2*k ∧ 3*k≤2*x); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let R := fun x n : ℕ => ∑ p ∈ (B x).filter (fun p => n-p ∈ B x ∧ p≤n), w p*w (n-p); ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ x≥X, (((J x).filter (fun n => R x n=0)).card : ℝ) ≤ ε*(x:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0044 · 内窗口中无中心素数对的偶数为零密度（开放目标）
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0044 · Density-zero exceptional set in an interior fixed-window model

brief.zh: 此目标改善有表示的偶数比例，同时放宽了每个成功目标的质量要求。研究固定窗口的主弧模型与系数均方误差；这里允许例外无限，不蕴含强哥德巴赫。 建议先读 L-goldbach-bulk-overlap-floor, L-goldbach-bulk-no-alias, L-goldbach-bulk-exception-budget。
brief.en: Seek a major-arc model with small coefficient mean-square error on the interior window. Even infinitely many exceptions are allowed. Read first: L-goldbach-bulk-overlap-floor, L-goldbach-bulk-no-alias, L-goldbach-bulk-exception-budget.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], 2<n → let odd := (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ n)).filter (fun χ => χ (-1) = -1); 2*odd.card=n.totient

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0049 · 模 n 奇特征的精确计数引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0049 · Exact number of odd characters at a fixed modulus

brief.zh: 由 −1 处的全体特征正交及各特征在该点取 ±1 得到。用于验证 2/φ(n) 是全体奇特征的平均。 证明提示：先确认平均因子为正再比较有符号和。
brief.en: Use full orthogonality at minus one and the two possible signs to recover the full averaging denominator. Proof hint: Establish the sign before comparing signed sums.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], 2<n → let odd := (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ n)).filter (fun χ => χ (-1) = -1); ∀ a b : (ZMod n)ˣ, ((2:ℂ)/(n.totient:ℂ))* (∑ χ ∈ odd, χ ((↑a : ZMod n)⁻¹)*χ (↑b : ZMod n)) = (if a=b then 1 else 0) - (if (↑a : ZMod n) = -(↑b : ZMod n) then 1 else 0)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0050 · 真实 Dirichlet 奇特征的有符号正交核引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0050 · Signed orthogonality kernel for actual odd Dirichlet characters

brief.zh: 把奇投影写成 (1−χ(−1))/2，分别调用全特征正交。单位条件保证求逆合法。 建议先读 L-goldbach-characters-odd-card。
brief.en: Apply full orthogonality at the two signed units after projecting with (1−χ(−1))/2. Read first: L-goldbach-characters-odd-card.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], 2<n → ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n, χ (-1) = -1 → χ.primitiveCharacter (-1) = -1

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0051 · 原始诱导特征保持奇性引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0051 · Parity passes to the primitive parent

brief.zh: 在模数变换恒等式中代入单位 −1。它允许零点按原始导子编组。 建议先读 L-goldbach-characters-odd-card。
brief.en: Evaluate the change-of-level identity at the unit minus one. Read first: L-goldbach-characters-odd-card.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], 2<n → let odd := (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ n)).filter (fun χ => χ (-1) = -1); ∀ d : ℕ, d∣n → 2<d → 2*(odd.filter (fun χ => χ.conductor ∣ d)).card = d.totient

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0052 · 按整除关系计算低导子奇特征数引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0052 · Count odd characters whose conductor divides a divisor

brief.zh: 在模 d 的奇特征和模 n 的低导子奇特征之间建立提升双射；这是按导子求和的计数基础。 建议先读 L-goldbach-characters-primitive-parity, L-goldbach-characters-odd-card。
brief.en: Identify the characters as the image of level change from odd characters modulo d. Read first: L-goldbach-characters-primitive-parity, L-goldbach-characters-odd-card.

gaps.statement: ∀ k : ℕ, 3≤k → let n := 2^k; ((Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ n)).filter (fun χ => χ (-1) = -1 ∧ χ.conductor=n)).card=2^(k-3)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0053 · 二幂高层的本原奇特征数引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0053 · Count exact-conductor odd characters at dyadic levels

brief.zh: 用相邻层的奇特征数作差；k=2 是单独的边界层。 建议先读 L-goldbach-characters-low-conductor-card。
brief.en: Take the difference between adjacent conductor levels, leaving level two separate. Read first: L-goldbach-characters-low-conductor-card.

gaps.statement: ∀ k : ℕ, 4≤k → let n := 2^k; let X := (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ n)).filter (fun χ => χ (-1) = -1); 2^(k/4)*(X.filter (fun χ => χ.conductor^4 ≤ n^3)).card ≤ X.card

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0054 · 二次幂子族低导子奇特征的比例界引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0054 · Power-saving fraction of low-conductor odd characters at dyadic moduli

brief.zh: 阈值 d⁴≤N³ 在二次幂塔上转为导子层数，再对低层计数。比例小仍需与每个特征的振幅界合用。 建议先读 L-goldbach-characters-low-conductor-card, L-goldbach-conductor-high-edge。
brief.en: Translate the cutoff into a level bound. A small fraction still needs a bound for the amplitudes carried by those characters. Read first: L-goldbach-characters-low-conductor-card, L-goldbach-conductor-high-edge.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], 2<n → let odd := (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ n)).filter (fun χ => χ (-1) = -1); ∀ f : (ZMod n)ˣ → ℝ, (2/(n.totient : ℝ))*(∑ χ ∈ odd, ‖∑ a : (ZMod n)ˣ, (f a : ℂ)*χ (a : ZMod n)‖^2) = (∑ a : (ZMod n)ˣ, (f a)^2) - ∑ a : (ZMod n)ˣ, f a*f (-a)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0055 · 单位群奇特征 Parseval 的反对角修正引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0055 · Odd-character Parseval with the antidiagonal correction

brief.zh: 在真实全体奇特征上展开平方，调用有符号核，保持实权；把频谱功率精确接回算术反射。 建议先读 L-goldbach-characters-odd-kernel, L-goldbach-odd-kernel-quadratic。
brief.en: Expand the squared amplitudes over actual odd characters and contract the signed kernel for real weights. Read first: L-goldbach-characters-odd-kernel, L-goldbach-odd-kernel-quadratic.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], 2<n → ∀ w : ℕ → ℝ, (∑ a : (ZMod n)ˣ, w (a : ZMod n).val * w ((-a : (ZMod n)ˣ) : ZMod n).val) = ∑ k ∈ (Finset.range n).filter (fun k => k.Coprime n), w k*w (n-k)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0056 · 单位群反射卷积拉回自然数闭区间引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0056 · Lift reflected unit-group correlation back to the interval

brief.zh: 对单位 a 的标准代表证明 (−a).val=n−a.val；换元到互素剩余类。 建议先读 L-goldbach-reflect-unit-support, L-goldbach-unit-anti-range。
brief.en: Use canonical representatives and the exact reflected representative for a unit. Read first: L-goldbach-reflect-unit-support, L-goldbach-unit-anti-range.

gaps.statement: ∀ k : ℕ, 2≤k → let n := 2^k; let X := (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ n)).filter (fun χ => χ (-1) = -1); (2/(n.totient : ℝ))*(∑ χ ∈ X, Real.log ((n:ℝ)/(χ.conductor:ℝ))) = (1-4/(2:ℝ)^k)*Real.log 2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0057 · 二幂模数上奇特征的平均对数导子亏损引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0057 · Exact average logarithmic conductor loss at powers of two

brief.zh: 将每个导子亏损写成跨层指标之和，计算各层的奇特征数，与算术公式独立对表。 建议先读 L-goldbach-characters-low-conductor-card, L-goldbach-conductor-dyadic-sum。
brief.en: Sum conductor deficits by levels and compare the character-side answer with the independent divisor formula. Read first: L-goldbach-characters-low-conductor-card, L-goldbach-conductor-dyadic-sum.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], 2<n → ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n, Real.log ((n:ℝ)/(χ.conductor:ℝ)) = ∑ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (Real.log (p:ℝ)) * (((Finset.Icc 1 (n.factorization p)).filter (fun j => χ.conductor ∣ n/p^j)).card : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0058 · 每个特征的对数导子亏损按素数层分解引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0058 · Expand individual log-conductor loss by prime layers

brief.zh: 以 χ.conductor∣n 为入口，逐素点计算 n/导子的赋值。每层只贡献一个 log p。 建议先读 L-goldbach-characters-primitive-parity。
brief.en: Use divisibility of the conductor and count its missing prime-power layers. Read first: L-goldbach-characters-primitive-parity.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], 2<n → let odd := (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ n)).filter (fun χ => χ (-1) = -1); ∀ d:ℕ, d∣n → d≤2 → (odd.filter (fun χ => χ.conductor ∣ d)).card=0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0059 · 小商模的奇特征层为空引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0059 · Small quotient moduli contribute no odd-character layer

brief.zh: 由原始奇性排除导子 1、2，防止误加 φ(2) 的贡献。 建议先读 L-goldbach-characters-primitive-parity。
brief.en: Exclude conductors one and two via primitive parity; do not charge phi(2). Read first: L-goldbach-characters-primitive-parity.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], 2<n → Even n → let odd := (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ n)).filter (fun χ => χ (-1) = -1); (2/(n.totient:ℝ))*(∑ χ ∈ odd, Real.log ((n:ℝ)/(χ.conductor:ℝ))) = ∑ p ∈ n.primeFactors, Real.log (p:ℝ) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n.factorization p), (if 2<n/p^j then ((n/p^j).totient:ℝ)/(n.totient:ℝ) else 0)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0060 · 一般偶模数的平均对数导子亏损公式引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0060 · Exact mean logarithmic conductor deficit at a general even modulus

brief.zh: 交换奇特征平均与素数层的有限和，逐层使用低导子计数和小商模例外。导子修正从谱量化为可独立计算的算术量。 建议先读 L-goldbach-conductor-deficit-layer, L-goldbach-conductor-exception-small-level, L-goldbach-characters-low-conductor-card。
brief.en: Swap the finite character and prime-layer sums, applying the low-conductor count except at quotient moduli one and two. Read first: L-goldbach-conductor-deficit-layer, L-goldbach-conductor-exception-small-level, L-goldbach-characters-low-conductor-card.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], 2<n → let odd := (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ n)).filter (fun χ => χ (-1) = -1); ((odd.filter (fun χ => χ.conductor^4≤n^3)).card : ℝ)*Real.log (n:ℝ) ≤ 4*∑ χ ∈ odd, Real.log ((n:ℝ)/(χ.conductor:ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0061 · 对数导子亏损控制一般模数的低导子质量引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0061 · Bound low-conductor mass by the mean logarithmic deficit

brief.zh: 对每个低导子特征收取至少 log n/4 的非负亏损。与精确均值合用，可逐模数诊断截断损失。 建议先读 L-goldbach-conductor-high-edge, L-goldbach-conductor-mean-exact。
brief.en: Charge a quarter of log n to each discarded character, using nonnegativity for all the others. Read first: L-goldbach-conductor-high-edge, L-goldbach-conductor-mean-exact.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p n : ℕ), p.Prime → ((Finset.range p).filter (fun k => k%p≠0 ∧ k%p≠n%p)).card = if p∣n then p-1 else p-2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0045 · 局部单位指标的反射相关精确计数引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0045 · Reflected correlation of the local unit indicator

brief.zh: 给 theta 局部陪集测试一个可校准的内积。先算单素点，再取复合模；这一步只检验单位支撑。 建议先读 L-goldbach-sieve-residue-dimension。 证明提示：诊断预指定测试数据在哪个坏点可能失去非零性。
brief.en: Calibrate the coset-test inner product at one prime before combining moduli; the support here is only the unit sieve. Read first: L-goldbach-sieve-residue-dimension. Proof hint: Detect a local obstruction for prescribed test data.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m r : ℕ) (c : Fin m → Fin r) (a : Fin m → ℝ) (b : Fin r → ℝ), let F := fun j => Finset.univ.filter (fun i => c i=j); let μ := fun j => (∑ i ∈ F j, a i)/((F j).card:ℝ); (∑ i, (a i-μ (c i))^2) ≤ ∑ i, (a i-b (c i))^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0046 · 陪集平均是平方误差最小的近似引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0046 · Coset means minimize quadratic reconstruction error

brief.zh: 用各纤维的方差恒等式。得到给定局部标签可达到的最佳重建误差，空纤维不会贡献。
brief.en: Compute the least possible reconstruction error for a fixed local label by a fiberwise variance decomposition.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m r : ℕ) (c : Fin m → Fin r) (R : Fin m ≃ Fin m) (S : Fin r ≃ Fin r) (a : Fin m → ℝ), (∀ i, c (R i)=S (c i)) → let F := fun j => Finset.univ.filter (fun i => c i=j); ∀ j, (∑ i ∈ F j, a (R i))/((F j).card:ℝ) = (∑ i ∈ F (S j), a i)/((F (S j)).card:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0047 · 反射交换的纤维平均保持正负分量引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0047 · Equivariant fiber averaging transports reflected components

brief.zh: 先构造反射给出的纤维双射，再比较两侧归一化。两侧纤维大小相等也是证明的一部分。 建议先读 L-goldbach-theta-fiber-projection。
brief.en: Transport the entire fiber with its counting normalization, not just the numerator. Read first: L-goldbach-theta-fiber-projection.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m r : ℕ) (c : Fin m → Fin r) (R : Fin m ≃ Fin m) (S : Fin r ≃ Fin r) (a : Fin m → ℝ), (∀ i, c (R i)=S (c i)) → let F := fun j => Finset.univ.filter (fun i => c i=j); let b := fun i => (∑ k ∈ F (c i), a k)/((F (c i)).card:ℝ); (∑ i, a i*a (R i)) - (∑ i, b i*b (R i)) = ∑ i, (a i-b i)*(a (R i)-b (R i))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0048 · 等变纤维模型的反射误差等于残差自相关引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0048 · Exact residual correlation for an equivariant fiber model

brief.zh: 两项混合内积均因纤维内残差均值为零而消失。将待控误差缩小为真正的素数残差相关。 建议先读 L-goldbach-theta-reflected-fiber, L-goldbach-theta-fiber-projection。
brief.en: Both mixed terms vanish fiberwise. The remaining signed residual correlation isolates what a local model cannot see. Read first: L-goldbach-theta-reflected-fiber, L-goldbach-theta-fiber-projection.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m r s : ℕ) (c : Fin m → Fin r) (h : Fin r → Fin s) (a : Fin m → ℝ), let B := fun (q : ℕ) (f : Fin m → Fin q) i => let F := Finset.univ.filter (fun k => f k=f i); (∑ k ∈ F, a k)/(F.card:ℝ); (∑ i, (a i-B s (h ∘ c) i)^2) - (∑ i, (a i-B r c i)^2) = ∑ i, (B r c i-B s (h ∘ c) i)^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0049 · 细化局部标签时的平方误差递减量引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0049 · Exact reduction in reconstruction error under partition refinement

brief.zh: 比较同一批素数权的不同局部精度，量出新增局部数据实际解释的能量。 建议先读 L-goldbach-theta-fiber-projection。
brief.en: Quantify how much energy a refined local descriptor explains on the very same input. Read first: L-goldbach-theta-fiber-projection.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let j := fun n q r : ℕ => (n+q-r)%q; ∀ n q r : ℕ, 0<q → r<q → (F n q r).card=(F n q (j n q r)).card

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0050 · 区间余类反射的精确计数引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0050 · Exact reflected class counts on a closed interval

brief.zh: 利用 k↦n−k 的区间双射；余类大小由 n 本身决定，不能预设相等的均匀网格。 建议先读 L-goldbach-theta-reflected-fiber。
brief.en: Use interval reversal, which pairs exact finite class sizes even when the period does not divide the interval length. Read first: L-goldbach-theta-reflected-fiber.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; let j := fun n q r : ℕ => (n+q-r)%q; ∀ n q : ℕ, 0<q → let b := fun k => A n q (k%q)/((F n q (k%q)).card:ℝ); (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), b k*b (n-k)) = ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, A n q r*A n q (j n q r)/((F n q r).card:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0051 · 局部模型的素数反射质量化为余类和引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0051 · Compute projected prime reflection from residue-class prime sums

brief.zh: 将陪集投影的抽象恒等式专门化到真素数对数权，保留空纤维和 n−k 的余类。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-sum-reflection, L-goldbach-theta-fiber-projection。
brief.en: Compute the model on true logarithmic prime weights, accounting for empty classes and the reflected index. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-sum-reflection, L-goldbach-theta-fiber-projection.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; ∀ q : ℕ, 0<q → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ n≥X, ∀ r<q, r.Coprime q → |A n q r/(n:ℝ)-1/(q.totient:ℝ)| ≤ ε

brief.en: Invoke PNT in arithmetic progressions at fixed modulus; take the maximum of the finitely many residue thresholds.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; ∀ n q r : ℕ, 0<q → r<q → ¬r.Coprime q → A n q r ≤ ∑ p ∈ q.primeFactors, Real.log (p:ℝ)

brief.en: Every nonunit prime divides q; bound the whole contribution independently of the interval length.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; let j := fun n q r : ℕ => (n+q-r)%q; ∀ q : ℕ, 0<q → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ n≥X, let R := (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => r.Coprime q ∧ (j n q r).Coprime q); |(∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, A n q r*A n q (j n q r)/((F n q r).card:ℝ))/(n:ℝ) - (q:ℝ)*(R.card:ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ)^2| ≤ ε

brief.en: Use AP mass in unit classes, bounded leakage in nonunit classes and exact fiber sizes. The signed residual remains for the true convolution. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-prime-gram, L-goldbach-coset-ap-mass, L-goldbach-coset-nonunit-bias, L-goldbach-theta-orthogonal-residual.

gaps.statement: let R := fun n q : ℕ => ((Finset.range q).filter (fun r => r.Coprime q ∧ ((n+q-r)%q).Coprime q)).card; ∀ n p a : ℕ, p.Prime → 0<a → R n (p^a)=p^(a-1)*(if p∣n then p-1 else p-2)

brief.en: A residue pair survives precisely when its reduction avoids both forbidden classes. Count all lifts. Read first: L-goldbach-theta-coset-factor.

gaps.statement: let R := fun n q : ℕ => ((Finset.range q).filter (fun r => r.Coprime q ∧ ((n+q-r)%q).Coprime q)).card; ∀ n a b : ℕ, 0<a → 0<b → a.Coprime b → R n (a*b)=R n a*R n b

plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0056 · CRT multiplicativity of reflected unit-pair counts

brief.zh: 构造单位余类双射，并验证余类反射在 CRT 下逐分量运算。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-sum-reflection。
brief.en: Build a CRT bijection that respects both the unit tests and additive reflection. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-sum-reflection.

gaps.statement: let R := fun n q : ℕ => ((Finset.range q).filter (fun r => r.Coprime q ∧ ((n+q-r)%q).Coprime q)).card; ∀ n q : ℕ, 0<q → (q:ℝ)*(R n q:ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ)^2 = ∏ p ∈ q.primeFactors, (p:ℝ)*(if p∣n then (p:ℝ)-1 else (p:ℝ)-2)/((p:ℝ)-1)^2

brief.en: Combine prime-power lifting, CRT and totient normalization, retaining the parity factor at two. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-primepower-lift, L-goldbach-coset-unit-crt, L-goldbach-coset-model-limit.

gaps.statement: let R := fun n q : ℕ => ((Finset.range q).filter (fun r => r.Coprime q ∧ ((n+q-r)%q).Coprime q)).card; ∀ n q : ℕ, 0<q → (0<R n q ↔ Odd q ∨ Even n)

plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0058 · Characterize the parity obstruction in every finite unit model

brief.zh: 对每个奇素点至少有一个允许类；二进素点恰在 n 为奇数时阻断。证明这个局部可解性结论后，真正的缺口仍是素数残差。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-primepower-lift, L-goldbach-coset-unit-crt。
brief.en: All odd local factors have an admissible class. Check parity at two and recombine; the actual prime residual remains. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-primepower-lift, L-goldbach-coset-unit-crt.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); ∀ n q : ℕ, 0<q → let s := (n+1)%q; (∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, (((F n q r).card:ℝ)-(n+1:ℕ)/(q:ℝ))^2) = (s:ℝ)*((q:ℝ)-s)/q

plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0059 · Squared rounding error over all endpoint classes

brief.zh: 将 n+1 个整数分为完整周期和一个长度 s 的余段。这个精确二阶量用于追踪模数随规模变化时的取整误差。
brief.en: Separate complete periods from the terminal segment; retain the exact finite-population variance.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let j := fun n q r : ℕ => (n+q-r)%q; let μ := fun q r : ℕ => if r.Coprime q then (q:ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ) else 0; let K := fun n q => ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, ((F n q r).card:ℝ)*μ q r*μ q (j n q r); let R := fun n q : ℕ => ((Finset.range q).filter (fun r => r.Coprime q ∧ ((n+q-r)%q).Coprime q)).card; ∀ n q : ℕ, 0<q → |K n q - ((n+1:ℕ):ℝ)*(q:ℝ)*(R n q:ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ)^2| ≤ ((q:ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ))^2*(R n q:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0060 · 局部主项取整误差依赖于有效余类数引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0060 · Rounding loss for the reflected singular coefficient

brief.zh: 只计算两个端点均为单位的余类。每类基数与均匀模型相差至多 1。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-normalized-euler。
brief.en: Charge at most one endpoint discrepancy for each doubly admissible class. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-normalized-euler.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; let j := fun n q r : ℕ => (n+q-r)%q; let μ := fun q r : ℕ => if r.Coprime q then (q:ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ) else 0; let v := fun n q r : ℕ => A n q r-((F n q r).card:ℝ)*μ q r; let G := fun n q => ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, A n q r*A n q (j n q r)/((F n q r).card:ℝ); let U := fun n q => ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, ((F n q r).card:ℝ)*(μ q r)^2; let E := fun n q => ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, (v n q r)^2/((F n q r).card:ℝ); let K := fun n q => ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, ((F n q r).card:ℝ)*μ q r*μ q (j n q r); ∀ n q : ℕ, 0<q → |G n q-K n q| ≤ 2*Real.sqrt (U n q*E n q)+E n q

plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0061 · Weighted mean-square transfer to the reflected model

brief.zh: 按真实纤维基数加权；反射保持该基数。分别对两个混合项用 Cauchy–Schwarz，再保留二次余项。此估计对可变 q 也成立。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-prime-gram, L-goldbach-coset-sum-reflection。
brief.en: Use invariant fiber sizes in two Cauchy–Schwarz estimates and a quadratic remainder. No fixed-modulus limit is assumed. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-prime-gram, L-goldbach-coset-sum-reflection.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; ∀ n q : ℕ, 0<q → (∑ r ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => ¬r.Coprime q), (A n q r)^2) ≤ (∑ p ∈ q.primeFactors, Real.log (p:ℝ))^2

plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0062 · Control total squared leakage into nonunit classes

brief.zh: 先证明各坏类的总质量上界再平方，避免按类重复收费 q 次。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-nonunit-bias。
brief.en: Combine the disjoint bad classes before squaring so prime divisors are charged only once. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-nonunit-bias.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; let μ := fun q r : ℕ => if r.Coprime q then (q:ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ) else 0; let v := fun n q r : ℕ => A n q r-((F n q r).card:ℝ)*μ q r; ∀ n q : ℕ, 0<q → let t := fun r : ℕ => if r.Coprime q then ((n+1:ℕ):ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ) else 0; (∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, (v n q r)^2) ≤ 2*(∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, (A n q r-t r)^2) + 2*((q:ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ))^2*(q:ℝ)

plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0063 · Move an AP variance bound to exact fiber normalization

brief.zh: 标准等差数列估计以长度除 φ(q) 为主项。把这项换成实际纤维基数乘局部密度，同时跟踪取整代价。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-rounding-profile, L-goldbach-coset-nonunit-l2。
brief.en: Convert the usual interval-length main term into fiber-count normalization, retaining the full rounding cost. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-rounding-profile, L-goldbach-coset-nonunit-l2.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; ∀ h b : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ n≥X, ∀ q : ℕ, 0<q → (q:ℝ) ≤ (Real.log (n:ℝ))^h → ∀ r<q, r.Coprime q → |A n q r - (n:ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ)| ≤ C*(n:ℝ)/(Real.log (n:ℝ))^b

plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0064 · Uniform prime mass in progressions up to logarithmic moduli

brief.zh: 走 Siegel–Walfisz 方向并将 Mangoldt 权换成真素数权；h、b 在取阈值之前固定。常数不要求有效。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-primepower-ap-budget。
brief.en: Seek the Siegel–Walfisz range with true prime weights, fixing both exponents before choosing the threshold. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-primepower-ap-budget.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; let j := fun n q r : ℕ => (n+q-r)%q; let G := fun n q => ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, A n q r*A n q (j n q r)/((F n q r).card:ℝ); let R := fun n q : ℕ => ((Finset.range q).filter (fun r => r.Coprime q ∧ ((n+q-r)%q).Coprime q)).card; ∀ h : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ n≥X, ∀ q : ℕ, 0<q → (q:ℝ) ≤ (Real.log (n:ℝ))^h → |G n q/(n:ℝ) - (q:ℝ)*(R n q:ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ)^2| < ε

plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0065 · Uniform reflected local main term on logarithmic moduli

brief.zh: 将均方传递、取整和非单位项与可选对数节省合成。余类范围现在可随 n 增长，结论仍仅涉及投影模型。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-logrange-ap, L-goldbach-coset-rounding-singular, L-goldbach-coset-l2-transfer, L-goldbach-coset-mean-square-rounding。
brief.en: Combine adjustable log savings, weighted transfer and rounding. The modulus range now grows with n, while the signed residual remains separate. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-logrange-ap, L-goldbach-coset-rounding-singular, L-goldbach-coset-l2-transfer, L-goldbach-coset-mean-square-rounding.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ n q r : ℕ, 2≤n → 0<q → r<q → let d := (∑ k ∈ F n q r, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k)-A n q r; 0≤d ∧ d ≤ C*Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)*(Real.log (2*(n:ℝ)))^2

plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0066 · Uniform square-root budget for replacing Mangoldt by prime mass

brief.zh: 把真素数幂贡献全部计入单个上界。统一于所有剩余类的平方根级损失可被任意固定对数幂节省吸收。 建议先读 L-goldbach-pp-count-squares, L-goldbach-pp-count-cubes, L-goldbach-pp-exp-cutoff。
brief.en: Dominate every class by total proper-power mass, retaining a square-root loss with explicit log powers. Read first: L-goldbach-pp-count-squares, L-goldbach-pp-count-cubes, L-goldbach-pp-exp-cutoff.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ n q : ℕ, 2≤n → 0<q → (∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, ((∑ k ∈ F n q r, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k)-A n q r)^2) ≤ C*(n:ℝ)*(Real.log (2*(n:ℝ)))^4

plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0067 · Squared prime-power leakage across all classes without a modulus loss

brief.zh: 将非负的误差按余类分割；平方和不超过总质量平方。逐类套上界再相加会多损失一个 q。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-primepower-ap-budget。
brief.en: Partition the nonnegative proper-power mass and square its total once, avoiding a loss of q. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-primepower-ap-budget.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; let μ := fun q r : ℕ => if r.Coprime q then (q:ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ) else 0; let v := fun n q r : ℕ => A n q r-((F n q r).card:ℝ)*μ q r; let E := fun n q => ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, (v n q r)^2/((F n q r).card:ℝ); ∀ n q : ℕ, 0<q → 2*q≤n → E n q ≤ (2*(q:ℝ)/(n:ℝ))*∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, (v n q r)^2

plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0068 · Transfer inverse fiber weighting to ordinary residue variance

brief.zh: 条件保证每一类至少覆盖 n/(2q) 个整数，避免对极短纤维失控。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-rounding-profile。
brief.en: Uniformly bound the inverse fiber size in a range where two full periods fit. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-rounding-profile.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; let Q := fun n : ℕ => n/(Nat.log 2 n)^8; let D := fun n q => Finset.sum (Finset.range q) (fun r => (A n q r-(if r.Coprime q then (n:ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ) else 0))^2); ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ n≥X, (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc (Q n) (2*Q n), D n q) ≤ C*(n:ℝ)*(Q n:ℝ)*Real.log (n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0069 · 大模数平均上的素数余类方差预算引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0069 · A dyadic large-modulus variance budget for prime residue masses

brief.zh: 以 Barban–Davenport–Halberstam 型均方定理为入口，须核对真素数与非单位类的代价。有界区间 q 约为 n/log⁸ n，结论容许个别坏模数。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-nonunit-l2, L-goldbach-coset-sparse-power-block。
brief.en: Use an AP mean-square theorem in the large-modulus range, accounting for prime-only weights and nonunit classes. Individual bad moduli are allowed. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-nonunit-l2, L-goldbach-coset-sparse-power-block.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; let μ := fun q r : ℕ => if r.Coprime q then (q:ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ) else 0; let v := fun n q r : ℕ => A n q r-((F n q r).card:ℝ)*μ q r; let E := fun n q => ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, (v n q r)^2/((F n q r).card:ℝ); let Q := fun n : ℕ => n/(Nat.log 2 n)^8; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ n≥X, (((Finset.Ioc (Q n) (2*Q n)).filter (fun q => ε*(n:ℝ) ≤ E n q)).card:ℝ) ≤ ε*(Q n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0070 · 大多数模数上的纤维加权误差小于目标尺度引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0070 · Sublinear fiber-weighted error for almost all moduli in the block

brief.zh: 把余类方差转为实际纤维加权的平方误差，然后对模数应用 Markov 不等式。量词允许坏模数随 n 变化。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-bdh-calibration, L-goldbach-coset-full-period-floor, L-goldbach-coset-mean-square-rounding。
brief.en: Transfer AP variance to inverse fiber weights and apply Markov over the moduli; the exceptional set may depend on n. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-bdh-calibration, L-goldbach-coset-full-period-floor, L-goldbach-coset-mean-square-rounding.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; let Q := fun n : ℕ => n/(Nat.log 2 n)^8; ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ n≥X, (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc (Q n) (2*Q n), ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, ((∑ k ∈ F n q r, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k)-A n q r)^2) ≤ (n:ℝ)*(Q n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0071 · 稀疏素数幂在长模数块上的能量损失引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0071 · Preserve the BDH logarithm when removing sparse prime powers

brief.zh: 每个纤维仅有 O(log⁸ n) 项；Cauchy 后对所有真幂平方权求和，平方根级稀疏性可吸收这些对数损失。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-rounding-profile, L-goldbach-pp-count-squares, L-goldbach-pp-count-cubes。
brief.en: Use the polylogarithmic fiber length and sparsity of proper powers before summing over the block. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-rounding-profile, L-goldbach-pp-count-squares, L-goldbach-pp-count-cubes.

gaps.statement: let R := fun n q : ℕ => ((Finset.range q).filter (fun r => r.Coprime q ∧ ((n+q-r)%q).Coprime q)).card; ∀ n q : ℕ, Even n → 0<q → (1:ℝ)/2 ≤ (q:ℝ)*(R n q:ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ)^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0072 · 所有偶目标的有限局部主项有统一正常数下界引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0072 · Uniform positive floor for every even target in the finite local model

brief.zh: 奇素数上最小因子是 1−1/(p−1)²；与所有整数 k≥2 的望远镜乘积比较。偶数的二进因子若出现则为 2。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-normalized-euler。
brief.en: Compare the worst odd-prime factors with the telescoping product over integers k≥2; keep the local factor at two. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-normalized-euler.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let μ := fun q r : ℕ => if r.Coprime q then (q:ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ) else 0; let U := fun n q => ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, ((F n q r).card:ℝ)*(μ q r)^2; ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ n q : ℕ, 0<q → U n q ≤ C*((n+1:ℕ):ℝ)*(Real.log ((q+2:ℕ):ℝ))^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0073 · 单位局部密度模型的能量随模数缓慢增长引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0073 · Polylogarithmic energy of the exact unit-class model

brief.zh: 由 q/φ(q) 的对数上界和精确总纤维大小得到；应保持常数与模数无关。
brief.en: Bound q/phi(q) logarithmically and use the total fiber mass, keeping the constant independent of q.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; let μ := fun q r : ℕ => if r.Coprime q then (q:ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ) else 0; let v := fun n q r : ℕ => A n q r-((F n q r).card:ℝ)*μ q r; let E := fun n q => ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, (v n q r)^2/((F n q r).card:ℝ); let Q := fun n : ℕ => n/(Nat.log 2 n)^8; ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ n≥X, (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc (Q n) (2*Q n), E n q) ≤ C*(n:ℝ)*(Q n:ℝ)/(Real.log (n:ℝ))^5

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0074 · 平均纤维误差保留五个对数幂节省引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0074 · A quantitative log saving for average weighted fiber error

brief.zh: 保留均方传递的收敛率，以抵消单位密度模型的能量增长。取整误差和标准主项从 n 到 n+1 的偏差也需计入。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-bdh-calibration, L-goldbach-coset-mean-square-rounding, L-goldbach-coset-full-period-floor。
brief.en: Preserve enough saving for the growing model energy, accounting for class rounding and the endpoint shift. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-bdh-calibration, L-goldbach-coset-mean-square-rounding, L-goldbach-coset-full-period-floor.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; let j := fun n q r : ℕ => (n+q-r)%q; let G := fun n q => ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, A n q r*A n q (j n q r)/((F n q r).card:ℝ); let R := fun n q : ℕ => ((Finset.range q).filter (fun r => r.Coprime q ∧ ((n+q-r)%q).Coprime q)).card; let Q := fun n : ℕ => n/(Nat.log 2 n)^8; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ n≥X, (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc (Q n) (2*Q n), |G n q/(n:ℝ) - (q:ℝ)*(R n q:ℝ)/(q.totient:ℝ)^2|) ≤ ε*(Q n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0075 · 大模数块上反射主项的平均绝对误差趋零引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0075 · Mean absolute error of the reflected model in the large-modulus block

brief.zh: 在模数求和之前保留混合误差的根号结构，用均方预算吸收增长的模型能量。平均不能直接升级为给定模数的保证。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-block-energy-rate, L-goldbach-coset-unit-energy-upper, L-goldbach-coset-l2-transfer, L-goldbach-coset-rounding-singular。
brief.en: Apply Cauchy–Schwarz across moduli to the mixed term, then add the rounding contribution. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-block-energy-rate, L-goldbach-coset-unit-energy-upper, L-goldbach-coset-l2-transfer, L-goldbach-coset-rounding-singular.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; let j := fun n q r : ℕ => (n+q-r)%q; let G := fun n q => ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, A n q r*A n q (j n q r)/((F n q r).card:ℝ); let Q := fun n : ℕ => n/(Nat.log 2 n)^8; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ n≥X, Even n → (((Finset.Ioc (Q n) (2*Q n)).filter (fun q => G n q ≤ (n:ℝ)/4)).card : ℝ) ≤ ε*(Q n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0076 · 每个大偶数在几乎所有该块模数上具有正投影质量引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0076 · Positive projected mass at most block moduli for each large even target

brief.zh: 次序是先固定偶数再允许例外模数。它不说真实反射残差有利；可与同一模数块的残差估计尝试相交。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-euler-lower, L-goldbach-coset-block-model-l1。
brief.en: Fix the even target first and allow exceptional moduli. A separate signed-residual result on the same block is required. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-euler-lower, L-goldbach-coset-block-model-l1.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; let j := fun n q r : ℕ => (n+q-r)%q; let B := fun n s : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k ≤ s ∧ s-k ≤ n), w k*w (s-k); let Z := fun n q : ℕ => ∑ s ∈ (Finset.range (2*n+1)).filter (fun s => s%q=n%q), B n s; ∀ n q : ℕ, 0<q → Z n q = ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, A n q r*A n q (j n q r)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0077 · 余类反射实际累计哪些不同的素数和引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0077 · Identify all aliased sums in the modular reflection mass

brief.zh: 先按和 s，再按第一个加数的余类重排同一批有序对；s 可偏离 n 的任意整倍数 q。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-prime-gram, L-goldbach-bulk-no-alias。
brief.en: Reindex the same ordered pairs by their sum and by the first residue; keep sums up to twice n. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-prime-gram, L-goldbach-bulk-no-alias.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; let j := fun n q r : ℕ => (n+q-r)%q; let G := fun n q => ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, A n q r*A n q (j n q r)/((F n q r).card:ℝ); let B := fun n s : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k ≤ s ∧ s-k ≤ n), w k*w (s-k); let Z := fun n q : ℕ => ∑ s ∈ (Finset.range (2*n+1)).filter (fun s => s%q=n%q), B n s; ∀ n q : ℕ, 0<q → |((q:ℝ)/((n+1:ℕ):ℝ))*Z n q-G n q| ≤ ((q:ℝ)/((n+1:ℕ):ℝ))*G n q

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0078 · 将精确投影质量转成常分母邻和模型引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0078 · Relative error from replacing exact fibers by a common size

brief.zh: 用每类基数偏差不超过一，把误差写成相对于本模数投影质量的量。空纤维不含素数权。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-rounding-profile, L-goldbach-coset-alias-mass。
brief.en: Bound each fiber's multiplicative deviation using its exact cardinality; empty fibers carry no mass. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-rounding-profile, L-goldbach-coset-alias-mass.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let B := fun n s : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k ≤ s ∧ s-k ≤ n), w k*w (s-k); let Z := fun n q : ℕ => ∑ s ∈ (Finset.range (2*n+1)).filter (fun s => s%q=n%q), B n s; ∀ n q : ℕ, 0<q → Z n q-B n n = (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n/q), (B n (n-h*q)+B n (n+h*q)))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0079 · 孤立原目标在常分母投影中的权重引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0079 · Isolate the original target's contribution to the alias model

brief.zh: 只有零偏移项给真实哥德巴赫质量；其余项分成对称的 ±hq，须同时保留截断窗口。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-alias-mass。
brief.en: Split the nonresonant aliases into symmetric positive and negative multiples with both support cutoffs. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-alias-mass.

gaps.statement: ∀ d Q : ℕ, 0<d → (∑ q ∈ (Finset.Ioc Q (2*Q)).filter (fun q => q∣d), (q:ℝ)) = (d:ℝ)* ∑ h ∈ d.divisors.filter (fun h => Q*h<d ∧ d≤2*Q*h), 1/(h:ℝ)

plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0080 · Switch large modulus weights to small complementary divisors

brief.zh: 使用 q↔d/q 的除数双射，区分严格下端点和闭上端点。此公式只用于 d>0。
brief.en: Use complementary divisors for positive shifts, retaining the half-open modulus block.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let B := fun n s : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k ≤ s ∧ s-k ≤ n), w k*w (s-k); let Z := fun n q : ℕ => ∑ s ∈ (Finset.range (2*n+1)).filter (fun s => s%q=n%q), B n s; ∀ n Q : ℕ, 0<Q → (∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc Q (2*Q), (q:ℝ)*(Z n q-B n n)) = ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (B n (n-d)+B n (n+d))*(d:ℝ)*(∑ h ∈ d.divisors.filter (fun h => Q*h<d ∧ d≤2*Q*h), 1/(h:ℝ))

plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0081 · Transform block alias mass into complementary-divisor weighted neighboring sums

brief.zh: 将投影模型可能由邻近系数解释的那一部分单独表达出来；当 Q 近 n/log⁸ n，互补除数仅为对数幂量级。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-divisor-switch, L-goldbach-coset-zero-shift-share。
brief.en: Make the neighboring-sum contribution explicit. The complementary divisors are polylogarithmic in the chosen large-modulus block. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-divisor-switch, L-goldbach-coset-zero-shift-share.

gaps.statement: ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), 0<a → a<b → (∀ u, u<a ∨ b<u → φ u=0) → let F := fun x => Real.exp (x/2)*φ (Real.exp x); (∀ x, x<Real.log a ∨ Real.log b<x → F x=0) ∧ HasCompactSupport F

plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0062 · Transport a central prime window to compact log support

brief.zh: 端点 a>0 保证对数窗紧。加权因子来自临界线 1/2 的 Mellin 测度。
brief.en: Track the compact support after taking logs and inserting the critical-line Jacobian.

gaps.statement: let W := fun (F : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => ∫ x : ℝ, (F x:ℂ)*Complex.exp (((t*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (a b t : ℝ), 0<a → a<b → Continuous φ → (∀ u, u<a ∨ b<u → φ u=0) → W (fun x => Real.exp (x/2)*φ (Real.exp x)) t = intervalIntegral (fun u : ℝ => ((φ u/Real.sqrt u:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.exp (((t*Real.log u:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I)) a b MeasureTheory.volume

plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0063 · Identify the critical-line Mellin weight after logarithmic substitution

brief.zh: 用 u=exp x 换元并核对正号相位、平方根权和体积元素。 建议先读 L-goldbach-mellin-log-support。
brief.en: Change variables u=exp(x), preserving the positive Fourier sign and the inverse square-root density. Read first: L-goldbach-mellin-log-support.

plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0064 · Exact spectral multiplier of the log-window derivative

brief.zh: 先证一次分部积分的无边界项公式；乘子的负号决定随后反演的相位。
brief.en: Integrate by parts with compact support; calibrate the multiplier sign before iterating.

gaps.statement: let W := fun (F : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => ∫ x : ℝ, (F x:ℂ)*Complex.exp (((t*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ) (m : ℕ), (∀ j : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ j F) → HasCompactSupport F → ∀ t : ℝ, |t|^m*‖W F t‖ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv m F x|

plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0065 · Bound Mellin frequency decay by the actual derivative norm

brief.zh: 保留导数积分作为显式常数。对 t=0 同时处理 m=0；大频尾估计需要 m 可选。 建议先读 L-goldbach-mellin-derivative-transport。
brief.en: Iterate the derivative identity and retain its derivative L1 cost, including the zero-frequency cases. Read first: L-goldbach-mellin-derivative-transport.

plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0066 · Control nearby zero weights by the first absolute log-window moment

brief.zh: 在积分号下应用弦长界。常数仅依赖窗口；它补上近邻零点的复权变化。 建议先读 L-goldbach-height-near-phase。
brief.en: Apply the chord bound inside the integral to control weight variation as well as phase variation. Read first: L-goldbach-height-near-phase.

gaps.statement: let Z := fun (m k : ℕ) (γ : Fin m → ℝ) => Finset.univ.filter (fun j => (k:ℝ) ≤ |γ j| ∧ |γ j| < (k+1:ℕ)); ∀ (m k a : ℕ) (γ : Fin m → ℝ) (W : ℝ → ℂ) (K : ℝ), 0≤K → (∀ t, ‖W t‖ ≤ K/(1+|t|)^a) → (∑ j ∈ Z m k γ, ‖W (γ j)‖) ≤ ((Z m k γ).card:ℝ)*K/((k+1:ℕ):ℝ)^a

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0067 · 带重数单位高度块的衰减质量估计引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0067 · Weighted mass in a unit absolute-height shell

brief.zh: 使用半开高度块使每个副本唯一归属，同时允许不同索引有相同高度。 建议先读 L-goldbach-mellin-decay-seminorm。
brief.en: Use half-open absolute-height bins so every copy is counted exactly once. Read first: L-goldbach-mellin-decay-seminorm.

gaps.statement: let Z := fun (m k : ℕ) (γ : Fin m → ℝ) => Finset.univ.filter (fun j => (k:ℝ) ≤ |γ j| ∧ |γ j| < (k+1:ℕ)); ∀ a : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ (m d H : ℕ) (γ : Fin m → ℝ) (W : ℝ → ℂ) (K L : ℝ), 1≤d → 0≤K → 0≤L → (∀ t, ‖W t‖ ≤ K/(1+|t|)^(a+4)) → (∀ k, ((Z m k γ).card:ℝ) ≤ L*Real.log ((d*(k+2):ℕ):ℝ)) → (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (H:ℝ) ≤ |γ i|), ‖W (γ j)‖) ≤ C*K*L*Real.log ((d*(H+2):ℕ):ℝ)/((H+1:ℕ):ℝ)^(a+2)

plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0068 · Uniform absolute tail bound from local zero counts

brief.zh: 按单位高度块求和后，把 log(d(k+2)) 切成起始高度项和剩余增长项。常数必须与家族大小、导子和截断高度无关。 建议先读 L-goldbach-mellin-unit-bin-budget。
brief.en: Sum over the shells, splitting conductor and height growth. The constant must be independent of family size, conductor and cutoff. Read first: L-goldbach-mellin-unit-bin-budget.

gaps.statement: let F := fun (φ : ℝ → ℝ) x => Real.exp (x/2)*φ (Real.exp x); let R := fun (f : ℝ → ℝ) h => ∫ x : ℝ, f x*f (x+h); ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous φ → (∀ u : ℝ, u < 1/3 ∨ 2/3 < u → φ u=0) → R (F φ) 0 = intervalIntegral (fun u : ℝ => (φ u)^2) 0 1 MeasureTheory.volume

plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0069 · Critical-line window energy equals the arithmetic diagonal mass

brief.zh: 将 F(x)² 中的 exp x 连同 dx 一起换为 du。它锁定显式公式中 log d 的系数。 建议先读 L-goldbach-mellin-log-identification。
brief.en: Use exp(x) dx = du in the squared log window to fix the coefficient of the log conductor. Read first: L-goldbach-mellin-log-identification.

gaps.statement: let F := fun (φ : ℝ → ℝ) x => Real.exp (x/2)*φ (Real.exp x); let R := fun (f : ℝ → ℝ) h => ∫ x : ℝ, f x*f (x+h); ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous φ → (∀ u : ℝ, u < 1/3 ∨ 2/3 < u → φ u=0) → ∀ h : ℝ, Real.log 2 ≤ |h| → R (F φ) h=0

plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0070 · Autocorrelation vanishes even at the critical shift log two

brief.zh: 两个对数支撑的长度恰为 log 2。等号时交集至多单点，必须在积分意义下处理；它决定素数 2 是否留下贡献。 建议先读 L-goldbach-mellin-log-support。
brief.en: At equality the translated supports can meet in one point only. Account for its zero measure to handle prime two. Read first: L-goldbach-mellin-log-support.

gaps.statement: let W := fun (f : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => ∫ x : ℝ, (f x:ℂ)*Complex.exp (((t*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let R := fun (f : ℝ → ℝ) h => ∫ x : ℝ, f x*f (x+h); ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → ∀ t : ℝ, (∫ h : ℝ, R f h*Real.cos (t*h)) = ‖W f t‖^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0071 · 有限窗自相关与平方频谱的精确变换引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0071 · Exact transform of the autocorrelation of a compact real window

brief.zh: 用 Fubini 展开二重积分；实权使相反频率互为共轭。频率约定不含 2π。 建议先读 L-goldbach-mellin-log-identification。
brief.en: Expand the double integral and identify conjugate frequencies in the no-2π convention. Read first: L-goldbach-mellin-log-identification.

gaps.statement: let F := fun (φ : ℝ → ℝ) x => Real.exp (x/2)*φ (Real.exp x); let W := fun (f : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => ∫ x : ℝ, (f x:ℂ)*Complex.exp (((t*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous φ → (∀ u : ℝ, u < 1/3 ∨ 2/3 < u → φ u=0) → (∫ t : ℝ, ‖W (F φ) t‖^2) = 2*Real.pi*(intervalIntegral (fun u : ℝ => (φ u)^2) 0 1 MeasureTheory.volume)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0072 · 校准零点测试函数的 Plancherel 常数引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0072 · Calibrate the Plancherel normalization of the zero test

brief.zh: 频率按 exp(itx) 定义，与 Mathlib 的 2π 约定换元。常数要与对角项 cφ 一致。 建议先读 L-goldbach-mellin-autocorr-diagonal, L-goldbach-mellin-wiener-khinchin。
brief.en: Convert the frequency convention explicitly and match the arithmetic cφ. Read first: L-goldbach-mellin-autocorr-diagonal, L-goldbach-mellin-wiener-khinchin.

gaps.statement: let F := fun (φ : ℝ → ℝ) x => Real.exp (x/2)*φ (Real.exp x); let R := fun (f : ℝ → ℝ) h => ∫ x : ℝ, f x*f (x+h); ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (b : ℕ → ℂ), Continuous φ → (∀ u : ℝ, u < 1/3 ∨ 2/3 < u → φ u=0) → (∑' k : ℕ, (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k : ℂ)*b k*(R (F φ) (Real.log (k:ℝ)):ℂ))=0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0073 · 中心窗使显式公式的素数幂侧完全消失引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0073 · Annihilation of the prime-power side by the central window

brief.zh: 将紧支撑与整数 k≥2 的离散位置相交；k=2 取等号，k=0、1 核对 Λ 值。允许一般特征系数。 建议先读 L-goldbach-mellin-support-exact-edge, L-goldbach-mellin-wiener-khinchin。
brief.en: Apply the exact support edge at k=2 and the Mangoldt values at zero and one; character coefficients are unrestricted. Read first: L-goldbach-mellin-support-exact-edge, L-goldbach-mellin-wiener-khinchin.

gaps.statement: let W := fun (f : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => ∫ x : ℝ, (f x:ℂ)*Complex.exp (((t*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); ∀ (f J : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ j : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ j f) → HasCompactSupport f → Continuous J → (∃ K : ℝ, ∀ t, |J t| ≤ K*(1+Real.log (2+|t|))) → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t : ℝ => ‖W f t‖^2*J t) MeasureTheory.volume

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0074 · 平方 Mellin 权乘对数增长仍可积引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0074 · Logarithmic archimedean growth is integrable against squared Mellin weight

brief.zh: 把 Γ 对数导数的实际增长估计隔离为输入，独立控制无穷远积分。 建议先读 L-goldbach-mellin-decay-seminorm。
brief.en: Isolate the growth estimate for the logarithmic derivative of gamma before integrating against the window. Read first: L-goldbach-mellin-decay-seminorm.

gaps.statement: let B := fun n p : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.log 2 n)).filter (fun a => n≤3*p^a ∧ 3*p^a≤2*n); ∀ n p : ℕ, 0<n → p.Prime → (B n p).card ≤ (if p=2 then 2 else 1)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0075 · 中心窗内一个坏素点最多留下两个幂次引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0075 · At most two powers per bad prime in the central window

brief.zh: 两次相邻幂的比为 p，而窗口端点比为 2；二进端点重合时保留两份。 建议先读 L-goldbach-pp-exp-cutoff。
brief.en: Use the endpoint ratio of two; retain both endpoint powers in the dyadic case. Read first: L-goldbach-pp-exp-cutoff.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 2≤n → (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => n≤3*k ∧ 3*k≤2*n ∧ ¬k.Coprime n), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) ≤ 2*Real.log (n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0076 · 中心窗中模数坏素点的 Mangoldt 总质量界引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0076 · Bound ramified Mangoldt mass inside the central window

brief.zh: 支撑只有 p|n 的素数幂，各 p 至多收两次 log p；最后用 rad(n)≤n。 建议先读 L-goldbach-primitive-window-powers。
brief.en: Sum log p over distinct ramified primes with at most two powers each, then use the radical bound. Read first: L-goldbach-primitive-window-powers.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 2≤n → (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => n≤3*k ∧ 3*k≤2*n ∧ ¬k.Coprime n), (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k)^2) ≤ 2*(Real.log (n:ℝ))^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0077 · 中心窗中删去坏素点的平方权代价引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0077 · Squared-weight cost of removing the ramified primes from the diagonal

brief.zh: 平方权对角必须单算：∑(log p)²≤(∑log p)²，系数 2 来自中心窗的端点。 建议先读 L-goldbach-primitive-window-powers。
brief.en: Handle the squared diagonal separately, preserving the factor two from the central window. Read first: L-goldbach-primitive-window-powers.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], 2<n → ∀ (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) (v : ℕ → ℂ), (∀ k, ‖v k‖≤1) → ‖∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => n≤3*k ∧ 3*k≤2*n), (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k:ℂ)*v k*(χ (k:ZMod n)-χ.primitiveCharacter (k:ZMod χ.conductor))‖ ≤ 2*Real.log (n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0078 · 诱导特征与原始母特征在中心素数和上的差引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0078 · Bound imprimitive-to-primitive replacement in the central prime sum

brief.zh: 在单位类上两特征相等；非单位类原模特征为零，原始母特征模至多一。损失只有一份坏素质量。 建议先读 L-goldbach-primitive-ramified-total, L-goldbach-characters-primitive-parity。
brief.en: Unit terms agree and the imprimitive value vanishes on nonunits, so only one copy of ramified mass is charged. Read first: L-goldbach-primitive-ramified-total, L-goldbach-characters-primitive-parity.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n], 2<n → let X := (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ n)).filter (fun χ => χ (-1) = -1); ∀ (A B : DirichletCharacter ℂ n → ℂ) (e : ℝ), 0≤e → (∀ χ∈X, ‖A χ-B χ‖ ≤ e) → let avg := fun f : DirichletCharacter ℂ n → ℝ => (2/(n.totient:ℝ))*∑ χ ∈ X, f χ; |avg (fun χ => ‖A χ‖^2)-avg (fun χ => ‖B χ‖^2)| ≤ 2*e*Real.sqrt (avg (fun χ => ‖B χ‖^2))+e^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0079 · 按原分母平均的特征功率替换误差引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0079 · Second-moment cost of replacing induced amplitudes by primitive ones

brief.zh: 将中心和除以 √n 后可取 e=2 log n/√n；用精确奇特征数把点态替换误差转成二阶矩误差。 建议先读 L-goldbach-primitive-induced-discrepancy, L-goldbach-characters-odd-card, L-goldbach-cross-block-l2-tail。
brief.en: After square-root normalization take e=2 log(n)/sqrt(n). Preserve the full odd-character average when replacing squared amplitudes. Read first: L-goldbach-primitive-induced-discrepancy, L-goldbach-characters-odd-card, L-goldbach-cross-block-l2-tail.

gaps.statement: let F := fun n q r : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r); let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let A := fun n q r : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ F n q r, w k; let j := fun n q r : ℕ => (n+q-r)%q; let B := fun n s : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k ≤ s ∧ s-k ≤ n), w k*w (s-k); let Y := fun (n q : ℕ) (z : ℂ) => (B n n:ℂ) + ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n/q), ((B n (n+h*q):ℂ)*z^h + (B n (n-h*q):ℂ)*(z⁻¹)^h); ∀ (n q : ℕ) (u : ℂ), 0<q → u≠0 → u^n*Y n q (u^q) = ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, (∑ k ∈ F n q r, (w k:ℂ)*u^k)*(∑ k ∈ F n q (j n q r), (w k:ℂ)*u^k)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0082 · 把偏移相位分配到原始的两个素数余类和引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0082 · Factor the signed shift phase across the two original prime fibers

brief.zh: 把每个有序对的权写为 u^(p+p′)，目标项带 u^n，负偏移则必须出现逆相位。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-zero-shift-share, L-goldbach-reflection-phase。
brief.en: Use u^(p+p′) before regrouping by residues; the central coefficient carries u^n and negative offsets require inverse phases. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-zero-shift-share, L-goldbach-reflection-phase.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let B := fun n s : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k ≤ s ∧ s-k ≤ n), w k*w (s-k); let Z := fun n q : ℕ => ∑ s ∈ (Finset.range (2*n+1)).filter (fun s => s%q=n%q), B n s; let Y := fun (n q : ℕ) (z : ℂ) => (B n n:ℂ) + ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n/q), ((B n (n+h*q):ℂ)*z^h + (B n (n-h*q):ℂ)*(z⁻¹)^h); ∀ (n q L : ℕ) (z : ℂ), 0<q → 0<L → IsPrimitiveRoot z L → (∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, Y n q (z^j))/(L:ℂ)=(Z n (q*L):ℂ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0083 · 平移相位取有限平均后仅保留倍数偏移引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0083 · Root-of-unity averaging selects divisible aliases

brief.zh: 使用原始 L 次单位根的正交性，同时检查负偏移和 h=0。这个任务给相位投影提供可独立核验的尺度转移。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-phase-fiber-factor, L-goldbach-coset-alias-mass。
brief.en: Use root orthogonality for positive, negative and zero shifts to identify the coarser frequency sampling with a refined arithmetic modulus. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-phase-fiber-factor, L-goldbach-coset-alias-mass.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let B := fun n s : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k ≤ s ∧ s-k ≤ n), w k*w (s-k); let Y := fun (n q : ℕ) (z : ℂ) => (B n n:ℂ) + ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n/q), ((B n (n+h*q):ℂ)*z^h + (B n (n-h*q):ℂ)*(z⁻¹)^h); ∀ (n q L : ℕ) (z : ℂ), 0<q → 2*(n/q)<L → IsPrimitiveRoot z L → (∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, ‖Y n q (z^j)-(B n n:ℂ)‖^2)/(L:ℝ) = ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n/q), ((B n (n+h*q))^2+(B n (n-h*q))^2)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0084 · 去掉中心项后相位能量等于邻和平方质量引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0084 · Energy of the twisted alias error equals neighboring coefficient energy

brief.zh: 采样数应使正负偏移彼此不碰撞。Parseval 给的是邻和能量，可以衡量仅看无扭曲模型会损失多少信息。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-phase-decimation。
brief.en: Choose enough samples to separate both signs and apply finite Parseval to the centered polynomial. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-phase-decimation.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let B := fun n s : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k ≤ s ∧ s-k ≤ n), w k*w (s-k); let Y := fun (n q : ℕ) (z : ℂ) => (B n n:ℂ) + ∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n/q), ((B n (n+h*q):ℂ)*z^h + (B n (n-h*q):ℂ)*(z⁻¹)^h); ∀ (n q L : ℕ) (z : ℂ), 0<q → 0<L → IsPrimitiveRoot z L → let H := n/q; let c := fun i : ℕ => if H ≤ i then B n (n+(i-H)*q) else B n (n-(H-i)*q); (∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, ‖Y n q (z^j)‖^2)/(L:ℝ) = ∑ r ∈ Finset.range L, (∑ i ∈ (Finset.range (2*H+1)).filter (fun i => i%L=r), c i)^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Theta 反射 · TH-0085 · 低采样率的二阶矩含有可计算的交叉偏移引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0085 · Resolve the cross-shift terms under undersampled phase measurements

brief.zh: 平移索引到 [0,2H] 后分余类；不同偏移落在同一桶时必须先求和再平方。 建议先读 L-goldbach-coset-phase-decimation, L-goldbach-coset-twist-l2。
brief.en: Move to nonnegative indices before grouping by residue. Coincident sampled frequencies add coherently inside each bucket. Read first: L-goldbach-coset-phase-decimation, L-goldbach-coset-twist-l2.

gaps.statement: let p := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let θ := fun n : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), p k; let g := fun (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (n k : ℕ) => Real.log (k:ℝ)*(φ ((k:ℝ)/n))^2; ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ), 1≤n → (∀ u : ℝ, u < 1/3 ∨ 2/3 < u → φ u=0) → (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (p k-1)*g φ n k) = - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (θ k-(k:ℝ))*(g φ n (k+1)-g φ n k)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0080 · 用切比雪夫前缀误差精确表示加权素数对角偏差引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0080 · Abel identity for the weighted prime diagonal discrepancy

brief.zh: 在 k=n 的端点窗口为零，左端切比雪夫误差也为零。公式允许使用一维素数定理估计对角。
brief.en: The terminal weight vanishes and the initial Chebyshev discrepancy is zero. Telescope the weighted prime discrepancy.

gaps.statement: let g := fun (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (n k : ℕ) => Real.log (k:ℝ)*(φ ((k:ℝ)/n))^2; ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → (∀ u : ℝ, u < 1/3 ∨ 2/3 < u → φ u=0) → ∃ K : ℝ, 0<K ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 2≤n → (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, |g φ n (k+1)-g φ n k|) ≤ K*Real.log (2*(n:ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0081 · 对角离散权的总变差只损失一个对数引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0081 · Total variation of the discrete logarithmic diagonal window

brief.zh: 将 log k 与平滑窗分别作差。导数的尺度为 1/n，中心支撑保证 log 的导数避开原点。
brief.en: Difference the logarithm and the smooth cutoff separately, using central support to bound the derivative away from zero.

gaps.statement: let g := fun (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (n k : ℕ) => Real.log (k:ℝ)*(φ ((k:ℝ)/n))^2; let c := fun φ : ℝ → ℝ => intervalIntegral (fun u : ℝ => (φ u)^2) 0 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let b := fun φ : ℝ → ℝ => intervalIntegral (fun u : ℝ => (φ u)^2*Real.log u) 0 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → (∀ u : ℝ, u < 1/3 ∨ 2/3 < u → φ u=0) → ∃ K : ℝ, 0<K ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 2≤n → |(∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, g φ n k)/(n:ℝ) - (c φ*Real.log (n:ℝ)+b φ)| ≤ K*Real.log (2*(n:ℝ))/(n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0082 · 等距采样恢复对角主项中的常数项引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0082 · Recover the constant term of the diagonal by a Riemann-sum estimate

brief.zh: 在中心窗上拆 log k=log n+log(k/n)。控制两个离散积分误差，保留 bφ 的符号与归一化。 建议先读 L-goldbach-diagonal-window-variation。
brief.en: Split the logarithm inside the central window, then bound the two quadrature errors independently. Read first: L-goldbach-diagonal-window-variation.

gaps.statement: let p := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let D := fun (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) => (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k.Coprime n), (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k)^2*(φ ((k:ℝ)/n))^2)/(n:ℝ); ∃ K : ℝ, 0<K ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), 2≤n → (∀ u, |φ u|≤1) → (∀ u : ℝ, u < 1/3 ∨ 2/3 < u → φ u=0) → |D φ n - (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (p k)^2*(φ ((k:ℝ)/n))^2)/(n:ℝ)| ≤ K*(Real.log (2*(n:ℝ)))^3/Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0083 · 对角改用真素数时的归一化平方权损失引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0083 · Normalized squared-weight loss from replacing Mangoldt by prime weights

brief.zh: 分别估计真幂平方权及被模数整除条件排除的素数质量，它们对差的符号相反。 建议先读 L-goldbach-primitive-ramified-square, L-goldbach-pp-count-squares, L-goldbach-pp-count-cubes。
brief.en: Separate the added proper powers from removed ramified primes; these enter with opposite signs. Read first: L-goldbach-primitive-ramified-square, L-goldbach-pp-count-squares, L-goldbach-pp-count-cubes.

gaps.statement: let p := fun k : ℕ => if k.Prime then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let θ := fun n : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), p k; let D := fun (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) => (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k.Coprime n), (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k)^2*(φ ((k:ℝ)/n))^2)/(n:ℝ); let c := fun φ : ℝ → ℝ => intervalIntegral (fun u : ℝ => (φ u)^2) 0 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let b := fun φ : ℝ → ℝ => intervalIntegral (fun u : ℝ => (φ u)^2*Real.log u) 0 1 MeasureTheory.volume; (∃ A : ℝ, 0<A ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 2≤k → |θ k-(k:ℝ)| ≤ A*Real.sqrt (k:ℝ)*(Real.log (2*(k:ℝ)))^2) → ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → (∀ u, |φ u|≤1) → (∀ u : ℝ, u < 1/3 ∨ 2/3 < u → φ u=0) → ∃ K : ℝ, 0<K ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 2≤n → |D φ n-(c φ*Real.log (n:ℝ)+b φ)| ≤ K*(Real.log (2*(n:ℝ)))^3/Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0084 · 一维切比雪夫平方根误差推出归一化对角的渐近式引理
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0084 · Transfer a one-dimensional square-root Chebyshev estimate to the diagonal

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let r := fun n : ℕ => (I n (high n) (high n)).re/(n:ℝ); ∀ n H : ℕ, ∀ e : ℝ, 0<n → 0<H → 0<e → (∑ j ∈ Finset.range H, (r (n+2*j))^2) < (H:ℝ)*e^2 → (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (H-1), max 0 (r (n+2*(i+1))-r (n+2*i))) ≤ e → -(2*e*(n:ℝ)) ≤ (I n (high n) (high n)).re

plain_statement.zh: 同窗局部能量与正变差推出次弧高高项下界
plain_statement.en: Recover a bulk minor-arc floor from compatible local budgets

brief.zh: 取窗口锚点并累加直到锚点的正增量。应用到父题需对每个充分大的偶数找到同一个满足两项预算的窗口，这一解析输入仍开放。
brief.en: Select an anchor and sum positive increments. The open analytic input is a common window satisfying both budgets at every sufficiently large even target.

gaps.statement: let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; ∀ n h : ℕ, 0<n → Q (n+h)=Q n → MeasureTheory.volume ((arcs n) \ (arcs (n+h))) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (4*(Q n:ℝ)^2*(h:ℝ)/((n:ℝ)*((n+h:ℕ):ℝ)))

plain_statement.zh: 同导子截断时移动主弧的薄壳测度
plain_statement.en: Measure of the moving arc shell on a cutoff plateau

brief.zh: 对每个既约分数比较半径。每个分母 q 至多 q+1 个中心，用两侧半径差作有限并上界。对数截断跳跃处需另作估计。 用于高高项的移位比较。
brief.en: Bound the two lost strips at each rational center and sum over denominators. Changes of cutoff remain outside this estimate. Downstream: shifted bulk minor-arc comparisons.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; ∀ n h : ℕ, 1≤n → (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, ‖S (n+h) (high (n+h)) t - S n (high n) t‖^2) ≤ 2*(h:ℝ)*Real.log ((n+h:ℕ):ℝ)^2

plain_statement.zh: 移动素数谱截断的无条件均方代价
plain_statement.en: Unconditional mean-square cost of shifting the prime cutoff

brief.zh: 用整数频率正交性化成系数平方和。新增频率至多 h 个；原有频率中退出的底数满足 n<k³≤n+h，由立方映射的单射性也至多 h 个。 用于高高项的移位比较。
brief.en: Apply orthogonality. Count the entering top frequencies and the exiting cubic-cutoff bases separately, using injectivity of cubing. Downstream: shifted bulk minor-arc comparisons.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); ∀ (H : ℕ) (t : ℝ), 0<H → Real.sin (2*Real.pi*t) ≠ 0 → ‖(∑ j ∈ Finset.range H, E (-2*(j:ℝ)*t))/(H:ℂ)‖ ≤ min 1 (1/((H:ℝ)*|Real.sin (2*Real.pi*t)|))

plain_statement.zh: 偶移平均的频率衰减与半整数共振
plain_statement.en: Frequency attenuation and half-integer resonance under even shifts

brief.zh: 用有限几何级数和三角不等式分别给出两个界。冻结谱与弧后可直接估计移频平均；接近半整数时不能指望此界给强衰减。 用于高高项的移位比较。
brief.en: Bound the geometric sum both trivially and by the chord length. Apply to a frozen spectrum and mask; the bound deteriorates near half-integers. Downstream: shifted bulk minor-arc comparisons.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let minor := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let midArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let medCore := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (midArcs n \ arcs n).indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let medSkirt := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (wideArcs n \ midArcs n).indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let deepMinor := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (wideArcs n)ᶜ.indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N₀ ≤ n → minor n = (medCore n + medSkirt n) + deepMinor n

plain_statement.zh: 无条件三带分解：对充分大的 n，次弧积分精确等于中弧核、中弧裙边与深次弧之和。
plain_statement.en: Unconditional three-zone split: eventually minor n = (medCore n + medSkirt n) + deepMinor n.

brief.zh: 可证分析基石：因 Q₀(n) ≤ Q₁(n) 最终成立，arcs ⊆ midArcs ⊆ wideArcs，由可测指示函数拆分积分即得。
brief.en: Provable analytic foundation: once Q₀(n) ≤ Q₁(n), nested inclusion arcs ⊆ midArcs ⊆ wideArcs splits the integral.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let K := fun (n : ℕ) (β : ℝ) => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), E ((k:ℝ)*β); let modelBand := fun (n A B : ℕ) => ∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc A B, ∑ a ∈ (Finset.range (q+1)).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q), intervalIntegral (fun t => (((∑ r ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r q), E ((r:ℝ)*(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ))) / (Nat.totient q : ℂ)) * K n (t - (a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)))^2 * E (-(n:ℝ)*t)) ((a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ) - (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))) ((a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ) + (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))) MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Even n → -(e * (n : ℝ)) ≤ (modelBand n (Q n) (Q₁ n)).re

plain_statement.zh: 无条件中弧模型非负下界：中弧核的 Ramanujan-Fejér 近似模型对所有充分大偶数恒至少为 −εn。
plain_statement.en: Unconditional medium-core model floor: the Ramanujan-Fejér model over Q(n) < q ≤ ⌊n^(1/3)⌋ satisfies Re(modelBand) ≥ −εn.

brief.zh: 可证分析基石：由 K_n(β)² e(-nβ) ≥ 0 且偶数处 c_q(n)·c_q(1)² ≥ 0（或平方因子展开后单边可控），模型实部实际上非负。
brief.en: Provable foundation: since K_n(β)² e(-nβ) ≥ 0 and c_q(a)² e(-na/q) sums symmetrically for even n, the model is actually nonnegative.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let Qqp := fun n : ℕ => ⌊Real.exp (Real.sqrt (Real.log (n:ℝ)))⌋₊; let K := fun (n : ℕ) (β : ℝ) => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), E ((k:ℝ)*β); let medCoreBand := fun (n A B : ℕ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => {u : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, A < q ∧ q ≤ B ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |u - (a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}.indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let modelBand := fun (n A B : ℕ) => ∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc A B, ∑ a ∈ (Finset.range (q+1)).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q), intervalIntegral (fun t => (((∑ r ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r q), E ((r:ℝ)*(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ))) / (Nat.totient q : ℂ)) * K n (t - (a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)))^2 * E (-(n:ℝ)*t)) ((a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ) - (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))) ((a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ) + (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))) MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Even n → ‖medCoreBand n (Q n) (Qqp n) - modelBand n (Q n) (Qqp n)‖ ≤ e * (n : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 开放子猜想（中弧 Siegel 准多项式带）：在模数带 (log₂ n)² < q ≤ exp(√(log n)) 内，真实中弧核与模型之差为 o(n)。
plain_statement.en: Open sub-conjecture (Siegel band): for (log₂ n)² < q ≤ exp(√(log n)), medCoreBand matches modelBand up to o(n).

brief.zh: 超出 Siegel-Walfisz 多项式对数界但仍远小于任意幂次；突破需排除 Siegel 零点或用 Deuring-Heilbronn 排斥精细控制。
brief.en: Beyond Siegel-Walfisz polylog moduli yet sub-polynomial; resolving it centers on ruling out or isolating Landau-Siegel zeros.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let Qqp := fun n : ℕ => ⌊Real.exp (Real.sqrt (Real.log (n:ℝ)))⌋₊; let Qzf := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/10:ℝ)⌋₊; let K := fun (n : ℕ) (β : ℝ) => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), E ((k:ℝ)*β); let medCoreBand := fun (n A B : ℕ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => {u : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, A < q ∧ q ≤ B ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |u - (a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}.indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let modelBand := fun (n A B : ℕ) => ∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc A B, ∑ a ∈ (Finset.range (q+1)).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q), intervalIntegral (fun t => (((∑ r ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r q), E ((r:ℝ)*(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ))) / (Nat.totient q : ℂ)) * K n (t - (a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)))^2 * E (-(n:ℝ)*t)) ((a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ) - (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))) ((a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ) + (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))) MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Even n → ‖medCoreBand n (Qqp n) (Qzf n) - modelBand n (Qqp n) (Qzf n)‖ ≤ e * (n : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 开放子猜想（中弧零点密度带）：在 exp(√(log n)) < q ≤ n^(1/10) 内，真实中弧核与模型之差为 o(n)。
plain_statement.en: Open sub-conjecture (zero-density band): for exp(√(log n)) < q ≤ n^(1/10), medCoreBand matches modelBand up to o(n).

brief.zh: 恰好位于 Gallagher 无对数零点密度定理的适用域边缘；难度集中在处理坏模数 q 并保留相位求和的均方抵消。
brief.en: Sits in the log-free zero-density / Linnik regime; requires uniform control over rare bad moduli with phase oscillation.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let Qzf := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/10:ℝ)⌋₊; let K := fun (n : ℕ) (β : ℝ) => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), E ((k:ℝ)*β); let medCoreBand := fun (n A B : ℕ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => {u : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, A < q ∧ q ≤ B ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |u - (a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}.indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let modelBand := fun (n A B : ℕ) => ∑ q ∈ Finset.Ioc A B, ∑ a ∈ (Finset.range (q+1)).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q), intervalIntegral (fun t => (((∑ r ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r q), E ((r:ℝ)*(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ))) / (Nat.totient q : ℂ)) * K n (t - (a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)))^2 * E (-(n:ℝ)*t)) ((a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ) - (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))) ((a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ) + (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))) MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Even n → ‖medCoreBand n (Qzf n) (Q₁ n) - modelBand n (Qzf n) (Q₁ n)‖ ≤ e * (n : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 开放子猜想（中弧 BV 越界带）：在 n^(1/10) < q ≤ n^(1/3) 内，真实中弧核与模型之差为 o(n)。
plain_statement.en: Open sub-conjecture (BV-range band): for n^(1/10) < q ≤ n^(1/3), medCoreBand matches modelBand up to o(n).

brief.zh: 此处模数数量约 n^(2/3) 个区间、每个区间短至 n^(2/3)，需要比 Bombieri-Vinogradov 更强的短区间或逐点频率-模数相关性估计。
brief.en: Each arc has length ~ n^(2/3)/(q) down to n^(2/3); requires sharp progression control with phase cancellation across q ≤ n^(1/3).

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let lowWideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let lowSkirt := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (lowWideArcs n \ arcs n).indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Even n → -(e * (n : ℝ)) ≤ (lowSkirt n).re

plain_statement.zh: 开放子猜想（低模主弧裙边）：围绕 q ≤ (log₂ n)² 主弧外扩至宽弧半径 H/(qn) 的裙边带满足单侧下界 −εn。
plain_statement.en: Open sub-conjecture (polylog-modulus skirt): the annulus around q ≤ (log₂ n)² out to radius H/(qn) has real part ≥ −εn.

brief.zh: 由于半径比主弧大了 Q₁ ≈ n^(1/3) 倍，在远离中心处 |S_n(t)| 缺乏 L¹ 绝对可和性，需在裙边内利用 Fejér 衰减与振荡。
brief.en: Extends well past the main lobe of K_n; requires balancing the 1/(q|β|) Jordan tail with prime progression errors.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let midArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let lowWideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let remSkirt := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => ((wideArcs n \ midArcs n) \ (lowWideArcs n \ arcs n)).indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Even n → -(e * (n : ℝ)) ≤ (remSkirt n).re

plain_statement.zh: 开放子猜想（中模宽弧裙边）：扣除低模裙边后的剩余中弧裙边带满足单侧下界 −εn。
plain_statement.en: Open sub-conjecture (medium-modulus skirt): the remaining wide-arc minus mid-arc skirt satisfies real part ≥ −εn.

brief.zh: 模数上至 n^(1/3) 且宽弧可能发生部分重叠，需要处理重叠容斥与远离有理中心的核衰减。
brief.en: Covers q ≤ n^(1/3) at wide radius H/(qn) where arcs may overlap and kernel tails interact.

let lowWideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let lowSkirt := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (lowWideArcs n \ arcs n).indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; plain_statement.zh: 中弧合成归约桥：三个模数带的模型逼近界、模型正性下界与两项裙边下界共同推出整个中弧区单侧下界 −εn。
plain_statement.en: Medium-zone assembly bridge: combining the model floor, three modulus-band approximations, and two skirt floors yields the medium-zone floor.

brief.zh: 以 ε/6 预算分配给模型下界、三条误差带与两条裙边带，已可由 Lean 4 内核严格证完。
brief.en: Allocates ε/6 to each of the six bounds and closes by triangle/real-part arithmetic.

plain_statement.zh: 无条件深次弧换权基石：在深次弧上将素数对数权替换为冯·芒戈尔特权所产生的积分差严格为 o(n)。
plain_statement.en: Unconditional deep-minor swap: replacing prime-log weights with Λ on deepMinor changes the integral by at most o(n).

brief.zh: 可证分析基石：对 (S_n(Λ)² - S_n(w)²) 因子分解后在单位圆做 L² Parseval + Cauchy-Schwarz，误差 ≤ 2 n^(3/4)(log n)²。
brief.en: Provable via L² Parseval and Cauchy-Schwarz on [0,1], bounding the difference by O(n^(3/4) (log n)²).

plain_statement.zh: 无条件 Type-I 消去基石：取截断 U = ⌊n^(1/16)⌋₊，在深次弧上初段与所有 Type-I 交叉积分贡献之和为 o(n)。
plain_statement.en: Unconditional Type-I elimination: at U = V = ⌊n^(1/16)⌋, all non-(Type-II × Type-II) Vaughan terms contribute o(n) on deepMinor.

brief.zh: 可证分析基石：在 wideArcsᶜ 上有 q > n^(1/3) 逼近，使 Type-I 和满足 ‖S_I(t)‖ ≪ n^(11/12 + o(1))，再结合 Parseval 得平方 L¹ 界为 o(n)。
brief.en: Provable foundation: deepMinor forces q > n^(1/3), giving power-saving on Type-I sums that pairs with L² Parseval for o(n).

plain_statement.zh: Type-II 矩阵格点 (1,1)：双因子均在平衡前缘带 (n^(1/16), n^(1/4)] 时，深次弧积分范数为 o(n)。
plain_statement.en: Type-II cell (1,1): deep-minor integral of τ₁ × τ₁ (both variables in (n^(1/16), n^(1/4)]) is o(n).

brief.zh: 可独立攻关格点：该带内因子规模仍远离 √n，单变量指数和尚可控至 n^(15/16+o(1))，重点在于在积分内榨干交叉保存。
brief.en: Most tractable corner cell; factors stay below n^(1/4), leaving room for pointwise or L⁴ dispersion savings.

brief.zh: 一侧带具有强色散保存，可用 Cauchy-Schwarz 配对另一侧的全周期 L² 能量攻击。
brief.en: Pairs a sub-n^(1/4) band with the (n^(1/4), n^(1/3)] band via dispersion and L² energy.

plain_statement.zh: Type-II 矩阵格点 (2,2)：双因子均在关键过渡带 (n^(1/4), n^(1/3)] 时，深次弧积分范数为 o(n)。
plain_statement.en: Type-II cell (2,2): deep-minor integral of τ₂ × τ₂ (factors in (n^(1/4), n^(1/3)]) is o(n).

brief.en: Right at the boundary of wide-arc denominator cutoff n^(1/3); needs bilinear or Kloosterman cancellation.

plain_statement.en: Type-II cell (2,3): deep-minor cross integral of τ₂ × τ₃ is o(n).

brief.zh: 连接过渡带与中心奇偶核心的交叉耦合项。

plain_statement.zh: Type-II 矩阵归约桥：由无条件换权、Type-I 消去及十个双线性元胞猜测推出深次弧单侧下界。

brief.en: Splits ε into 18 pieces across the swap, Type-I elimination, and all 16 expanded bilinear weights.

plain_statement.zh: 无条件二倍区间深次弧二阶矩：对固定宽弧遮罩 (wideArcs n)ᶜ，在 [n, 2n] 上的傅里叶系数平方和至多为 n^(8/3+η)。
plain_statement.en: Unconditional deep-minor second moment: for the fixed mask (wideArcs n)ᶜ, ∑_{m=n}^{2n} ‖deepCoeff n m‖² ≤ n^(8/3+η).

brief.zh: 可证分析基石：由 Bessel 不等式得平方和 ≤ ∫_{(wideArcs n)ᶜ} |S_n|⁴ dt ≤ (sup |S_n|)² · ∫₀¹ |S_n|² dt ≪ (n^(5/6+η/4))² · n log n。
brief.en: Provable via Bessel's inequality bounded by (sup_{deep} |S_n|)² · L²(S_n) ≪ n^(5/3 + η/2) · n log n.

plain_statement.zh: 开放子猜想（深次弧拟最优四阶矩）：S_n(w) 在深次弧 (wideArcs n)ᶜ 上的四次积分至多为 n^(2+η)。
plain_statement.en: Open sub-conjecture (deep-minor fourth moment): ∫_{(wideArcs n)ᶜ} |S_n(w, t)|⁴ dt ≤ n^(2+η).

brief.zh: 全圆 ∫₀¹ |S_n|⁴ dt ≈ n² (log n)⁴ 本身已知在主弧处占主导，此猜想断言扣除宽主弧后剩下的四阶矩仍不超过 n^(2+η) 且比平凡 n^(8/3) 强得多。
brief.en: Improves the trivial n^(8/3+η) fourth-moment cap down to the square-root cancellation threshold n^(2+η) on deepMinor.
