plain_statement.zh: 开放子猜想（深次弧 3/4 幂逐点估计）：在宽弧补集上将已知的 5/6 幂节省推进至 n^(3/4+η)。
plain_statement.en: Open sub-conjecture (3/4-power saving on deepMinor): improve the unconditional 5/6 bound to ‖S_n(w,t)‖ ≤ n^(3/4+η) outside wideArcs.

brief.zh: 将无条件指数 5/6 降至 3/4 虽仍不足以用绝对值直接得 o(n)（需 < 1/2），但能立刻把二倍区间例外数压至 X^(1/2+ε)（无条件接近 GRH 水平）。
brief.en: Stronger than the unconditional 5/6 exponent and matches the 3/4 circle-model regime yielding √X exceptions.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let deepMinor := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (wideArcs n)ᶜ.indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let deepCoeff := fun (n m : ℕ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (wideArcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => (S n w u)^2 * E (-(m:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ (η : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 < η ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Even n → ∃ ω : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ ω m) ∧ ((∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc n (2 * n), (ω m) ^ 2) * (n : ℝ) ^ (8 / 3 + η) ≤ ((e / 2) * (n : ℝ)) ^ 2) ∧ (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc n (2 * n), ω m * (deepCoeff n m).re) - (e / 2) * (n : ℝ) ≤ (deepMinor n).re

plain_statement.zh: 开放子猜想（反尖峰局部加权平滑）：任意坏偶数 n 处深次弧贡献不显著低于 [n, 2n] 内的局部非负加权平均（权 L² 范数 ≤ (ε/2)² n^(-2/3-η)）。
plain_statement.en: Open sub-conjecture (anti-spike local smoothing): Re(deepMinor n) is bounded below by a localized nonnegative average on [n, 2n] of L²-weight ≤ (ε/2)² n^(-2/3-η) minus (ε/2)n.

brief.zh: 把“防止单个偶数出现孤立负尖峰”定量化：只要存在支撑长度 ≫ n^(2/3+η) 的平滑核把邻近偶数传递到 n，即可直接与无条件二阶矩相乘闭合。
brief.en: Quantifies anti-spike oscillation: any nonnegative smoothing kernel of effective width ≫ n^(2/3+η) closes via the unconditional second moment.

plain_statement.zh: 二阶矩-反尖峰归约桥：无条件 X^(8/3+η) 二阶矩与反尖峰平滑转移猜想直接推出深次弧单侧下界 −εn。
plain_statement.en: Second-moment anti-spike bridge: the unconditional X^(8/3+η) second moment plus anti-spike smoothing imply the deepMinor floor.

brief.zh: 对平滑核与 deepCoeff 实部直接应用有限和 Cauchy-Schwarz（Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq），Lean 内核零难度通过。
brief.en: Applies finite Cauchy-Schwarz between ω and Re(deepCoeff) against the unconditional X^(8/3+η) energy bound.

brief.en: Establishes that GRH resolves all medium zones completely, isolating the remaining Goldbach difficulty inside deepMinor.

plain_statement.zh: GRH 深次弧等价归约桥：在 GRH 与三带分解下，整个次弧目标完全等价于深次弧单个区域的单侧下界。
plain_statement.en: GRH deep-minor reduction bridge: under GRH, L-goldbach-arc-minor-saving reduces solely to the deepMinor signed floor.

brief.en: Combines GRH medium-zone clearance with the deepMinor floor to deduce L-goldbach-arc-minor-saving.

plain_statement.en: Master unconditional zone bridge: the three-zone split, medium-zone floor, and deepMinor floor jointly imply L-goldbach-arc-minor-saving.

brief.zh: 把前沿一、二、三三条无条件路线统一收束到最终父命题。
brief.en: Master junction connecting Tracks 1, 2, and 3 to the parent target.

plain_statement.en: Classic open frontier (no Landau-Siegel zeros): real Dirichlet L-functions have no real zeros in (1 − c/log(q+2), 1).

brief.en: Standalone classical barrier underlying effective Siegel-band progression control.

plain_statement.en: Open frontier (level-3/5 Bombieri-Vinogradov): prime progression errors average to O(X/(log X)^A) up to q ≤ X^(3/5), strictly weaker than full Elliott-Halberstam.

plain_statement.zh: 开放子猜想（推进至 √n 模数的扩展次弧带）：在 n^(1/3) < q ≤ √n / (log₂ n)⁴ 带域上单侧贡献至少 −εn。
plain_statement.en: Open sub-conjecture (√n-scale extended arc band): the annulus between wideArcs (n^(1/3)) and sqrtArcs (√n / (log n)⁴) has real part ≥ −εn.

brief.zh: 位于 1/3 立方根截断与 1/2 平方根不相交上限之间；能把深次弧的模数门槛由 n^(1/3) 抬高至接近 n^(1/2)。
brief.en: Bridges the gap from n^(1/3) up to the √n/(log n)⁴ disjointness frontier before deepMinor.

plain_statement.en: Unconditional spatial 4-part identity: eventually Re(minor n) = diagTerm n − offLowNear n − offLowFar n − offHighMod n.

brief.zh: 可证分析基石：在 2 Q(n)² < n 后主弧两两不相交且 q=1 边界回卷合并，逐项计算 E((j+k-n)t) 的傅里叶积分即得。
brief.en: Provable foundation: once 2 Q(n)² < n, evaluate the Fourier integrals of arcs(n) and group modes by |j+k-n| and q.

plain_statement.en: Open sub-conjecture (near-diagonal low-mod match): for |j+k−n| ≤ n/√(log₂ n), offLowNear n equals seriesLow n up to o(n).

brief.en: Captures whether local averages of R(n+m) over |m| ≤ n/√(log₂ n) recover the truncated singular series seriesLow n.

plain_statement.en: Open sub-conjecture (diagonal vs high-modulus margin): offHighMod n + seriesLow n − diagTerm n ≤ εn for all large even n.

brief.en: Balances the zero-mode diagTerm n against high-modulus Ramanujan-sinc correlations and seriesLow n.

plain_statement.zh: 物理空间对偶归约桥：结合空间四分恒等式与三条空间 Ramanujan-sinc 子猜想直接推出 L-goldbach-arc-minor-saving。
plain_statement.en: Spatial assembly bridge: combining the 4-part spatial split with the 3 spatial sinc sub-conjectures implies L-goldbach-arc-minor-saving.

brief.zh: 将 ε 三等分为 ε/3 分别代入三条空间估计，由 Lean 4 内核严格证完。
brief.en: Allocates ε/3 to each of the three spatial bounds and closes via abs_le and linarith.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-7001 · 固定模数的四窗同余
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-7001 · Congruences at four scales with a fixed modulus

brief.zh: 先由支撑界定和与差，再分别处理 j=0 和 j>0。容许 8 不整除 n。
brief.en: Bound the sum and difference using the support, then split j=0 from j>0. No divisibility by 8 is required.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (X : ℝ), 2 ≤ n → 0 < X → X ≤ n → (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => ¬ Nat.Coprime k n ∧ X/3 ≤ (k:ℝ) ∧ (k:ℝ) ≤ 2*X/3), (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k)^2) ≤ 2*(Real.log n)^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-7002 · 固定模数坏素数的窗内平方质量
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-7002 · Square mass of ramified prime bases in a window

brief.zh: 按底数分组。每个底数的两个相邻指数已占满长度比为 2 的窗，再用素因子对数和。
brief.en: Group by prime base. The window has endpoint ratio 2. Bound the sum of the logarithms of the prime divisors.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-7003 · 四尺度核的三次消去
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-7003 · Cubic cancellation in the four-scale kernel

brief.zh: 将尺度相位视为同一个复比值。等高项对应比值为 1。
brief.en: Use the same complex ratio for all four scales. Equal heights give ratio 1.

gaps.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (w z : ι → ℂ) (δ L : ℝ), 0 ≤ δ → 0 ≤ L → (∑ i ∈ s, ‖w i‖) ≤ L → (∀ i ∈ s, ‖1-z i‖ ≤ δ) → ‖∑ i ∈ s, w i * (1-z i)^3‖ ≤ L*δ^3

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-7004 · 共振带可以用同一总权预算
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-7004 · Total-weight budget for a union of resonant bands

brief.zh: 一次三角不等式覆盖全部选定指标，预算与共振带数无关。
brief.en: Apply the triangle inequality to the entire selected set. The bound is independent of the number of bands.

gaps.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} [DecidableEq ι] (s t : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ), t ⊆ s → (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) → (∑ ij ∈ (s.product s).filter (fun ij => ij.1 ∈ t ∨ ij.2 ∈ t), w ij.1*w ij.2) ≤ 2*(∑ i ∈ s, w i)*(∑ i ∈ t, w i)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-7005 · 零点对的单尾并集预算
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-7005 · Product-weight bound for either coordinate in the tail

brief.zh: 由两个子矩形的积估计，允许两坐标同时进入尾部。
brief.en: Dominate the union by two product rectangles, allowing both coordinates to lie in the tail.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-7006 · 远频差强制至少一个高度过线
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-7006 · Large gaps force one large height

brief.zh: 和零点对预算配合，使频差尾依赖单个高度尾。
brief.en: Combine with the product-weight bound to use only a one-coordinate height tail.

gaps.statement: ∀ (h g t : ℝ) (m : ℤ) (k : ℕ), h-g=2*Real.pi*(m:ℝ) → Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((((k:ℝ)+t)*h:ℝ):ℂ)) = Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((((k:ℝ)+t)*g:ℝ):ℂ)) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((2*Real.pi*(m:ℝ)*t:ℝ):ℂ))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-7007 · 折叠到圆周后的绕数修正
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-7007 · Winding correction when folding a phase

brief.zh: 用指数加法拆掉整数绕数项。非二次幂由小数尺度保留额外相位。
brief.en: Split the exponential and remove the integer winding term. Fractional logarithmic scales retain the extra phase.

gaps.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (eigen w : ι → ℝ) (A B Q : ℝ), 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ B → 0 ≤ Q → (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i ∧ eigen i ≤ B) → (∑ i ∈ s, w i) ≤ Q → (∑ i ∈ s.filter (fun i => A < eigen i), w i) ≤ A*Q/(2*(B+1)) → (∑ i ∈ s, eigen i*w i) ≤ (3/2)*A*Q

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-7008 · 指定向量的正谱尾预算
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-7008 · Positive spectral tail budget for one vector

brief.zh: 在阈值 A 切分谱和，只界该向量的谱质量。连续或无限谱还需极限适配。
brief.en: Split at A and use only the spectral mass of the chosen vector. A limit argument is still needed for an infinite spectrum.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Y : ℝ), (∑ d ∈ n.divisors.filter (fun d : ℕ => (d:ℝ) ≤ Y), (Nat.totient d:ℝ)) ≤ max 0 Y * (n.divisors.card:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-7009 · 一般偶模的低导子总容量
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-7009 · Capacity of small conductor layers

plain_statement.en: New route · Skirts and explicit arithmetic inputs · SI-8001 · Expose the unweighted variable in the fourth band

brief.zh: a>B≥1 时全 Möbius 除数和为零。把补和取负，写 a=dℓ，保留 b≤n/(B+1) 和 ℓ 的两个取整端点。取 B=⌊n^(2/3)⌋。
brief.en: For a>B≥1 the full Möbius divisor sum vanishes. Negate the short complement, set a=dℓ and keep both floors and b≤n/(B+1). Use B=⌊n^(2/3)⌋.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); ∀ (A B h q a : ℕ), 0 < q → Nat.Coprime a q → let z := E ((a:ℝ)*h/q); ‖∑ l ∈ Finset.Ioc A B, E ((a:ℝ)*h*l/q)‖ ≤ if q ∣ h then ((B-A:ℕ):ℝ) else min ((B-A:ℕ):ℝ) (2/‖1-z‖)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 裙边与显式算术输入 · SI-8002 · 在有理中心显式分出自由因子的共振类
plain_statement.en: New route · Skirts and explicit arithmetic inputs · SI-8002 · Separate the resonant free factors at a rational center

brief.zh: 取 h=bd。既约性使共振条件等于 q∣bd；对其余项求几何级数。偏离中心的相位和与第三带的交项仍待估计。
brief.en: Take h=bd. Coprimality makes q∣bd the exact resonance condition. Sum the geometric series off resonance. Nearby phases and the cross term with band three still need estimates.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); ∀ (q : ℕ) (j : ℤ) (h H : ℝ), 0 < q → 0 ≤ h → h ≤ H → let A := (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q); let T := fun (a : ℕ) (r : ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun u => E ((j:ℝ)*((a:ℝ)/q+u))) (-r) r MeasureTheory.volume; (∑ a ∈ A, (T a H - T a h)) = (∑ a ∈ A, E ((j:ℝ)*a/q)) * ((if j=0 then 2*(H-h) else (Real.sin (2*Real.pi*j*H)-Real.sin (2*Real.pi*j*h))/(Real.pi*j) : ℝ):ℂ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 裙边与显式算术输入 · SI-8003 · 计算一圈既约中心上成对裙边的 Ramanujan–sinc 核
plain_statement.en: New route · Skirts and explicit arithmetic inputs · SI-8003 · Compute the Ramanujan–sinc kernel across paired annuli

brief.zh: 固定偏移 j，分别积分 ±β，再求既约分子和。q=1 用中心 0 两侧的周期延拓；在全弧集合应用时须验证分离。供低模裙边和中模剩余裙边共用。
brief.en: Integrate the symmetric offsets at fixed j before summing reduced numerators. Use the periodic wrap at center zero for q=1. Check separation when summing actual arc sets. Both skirts use this kernel.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n D E Q : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B → (∀ p ≤ n, w p ≤ B) → let P := (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ ((Finset.Ioc D E).filter (fun r => Nat.Prime r ∧ ((Finset.Ioc r Q).filter (fun q => Nat.Prime q ∧ p+r*q=n)).Nonempty)).Nonempty); (∑ p ∈ P, w p) ≤ B * (∑ r ∈ (Finset.Ioc D E).filter Nat.Prime, ((min Q (n/r)-r:ℕ):ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖续批 · FR-8008 · 为明确较小因子带内的平方自由半素数贡献给出上界
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage II · FR-8008 · Bound the distinct-factor semiprime mass in a specified smaller-factor band

brief.zh: 用唯一较小素因子分拆候选。固定 r，把候选注入 r<q≤min(Q,n/r) 的区间。计算所得上界可与同权的陈氏下界比较，完整因子区间仍需逐 n 的更精细估计。
brief.en: Partition by the unique smaller prime factor. For each r, inject into the interval r<q≤min(Q,n/r). A same-weight Chen lower bound can be compared with this budget. The full factor range still needs sharper bounds for each n.

gaps.statement: let P := fun n : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (Nat.sqrt (n-p)) ∧ (Nat.sqrt (n-p))^2=n-p); ∀ n : ℕ, 4000000000000000000 ≤ n → ((P n).card:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ)/(10^6*(Real.log n)^2)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖续批 · FR-8007 · 给无权陈氏计数中的平方损失一个百万分之一预算
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage II · FR-8007 · Give the unweighted Chen count an explicit prime-square loss

brief.zh: 先用平方根个数界。log²(x)/√x 在 x≥C 单调下降，在 C 处小于 10⁻⁶。可与同一 n 的无权陈氏下界比较。
brief.en: Bound the count by √n. The ratio log²(x)/√x decreases for x≥C and is below 10⁻⁶ at C. Compare with the unweighted Chen lower bound at the same n.

gaps.statement: let P := fun n : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (Nat.sqrt (n-p)) ∧ (Nat.sqrt (n-p))^2=n-p); ∀ (n : ℕ) (v : ℕ → ℝ), (∑ p ∈ P n, v p) = ∑ a ∈ (Finset.Icc 2 (Nat.sqrt n)).filter (fun a => Nat.Prime a ∧ Nat.Prime (n-a^2)), v (n-a^2)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖续批 · FR-8006 · 在同一权下精确移除陈氏候选中的素数平方余项
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage II · FR-8006 · Remove prime-square remainders with the same Chen weight

brief.zh: 以 p↔a、p+a²=n 建立双射。右边撤去 p 后仍保留 v(n−a²)。平方自由半素数须另外去除。
brief.en: Use p+a²=n for the bijection and keep v(n−a²) on the right. Distinct-factor semiprimes require a further estimate.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖续批 · FR-8001 · 核验已发表端点之后连续 64 个偶数的素数见证
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage II · FR-8001 · Verify prime witnesses for the next 64 even numbers beyond the published cutoff

brief.zh: RFC 列出按 j 排序的候选。逐行核验两侧素性，可用 n−p−1 的因子证书。覆盖 C+2 至 C+128 的所有偶数。
brief.en: The RFC lists candidates by j. Verify both primes in each row, for example with certificates factoring n−p−1. The block covers every even integer from C+2 to C+128.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → Even n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp 5) → ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ 2 ≤ n-p ∧ (n-p).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 47 ∧ ((n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → (n-p).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 14)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖续批 · FR-8005 · 把两个原型区间的因子数上界降到 14 和 47
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage II · FR-8005 · Improve the two prototype factor bounds to 14 and 47

brief.zh: 用 23^Ω≤n−p 并验证 exp(3.8)<15 log 23、exp(5)<48 log 23。小于 210235 时 n=4 单列，其余偶数取 p=3 后用奇因子 ≥3。
brief.en: Use 23^Ω≤n−p and verify exp(3.8)<15 log 23 and exp(5)<48 log 23. Below 210235 handle 4 separately and take p=3 for the other evens, whose remainder has only odd factors.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 210235 ≤ n → Even n → ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ p ≤ 210233 ∧ 2 ≤ n-p ∧ Nat.Coprime (n-p) 9699690

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖续批 · FR-8004 · 在完整模 9699690 的轮筛上构造 23 粗余项
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage II · FR-8004 · Construct a 23-rough remainder on the full 9699690 wheel

brief.zh: 先用 n%30030 选基类，再从三候选删去模 17 或 19 命中的至多两项。整数门槛保证差至少为二。
brief.en: Use n%30030 for the base class. Among its three candidates remove at most two forbidden by 17 and 19. The integer cutoff leaves a difference of at least two.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖续批 · FR-8003 · 为十二个基类各核验三个互补的素数提升
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage II · FR-8003 · Certify three complementary prime lifts for each of twelve classes

brief.zh: 逐行使用 RFC 的三素数证书，检查两个模数各自的互异性。17 与 19 各至多排除一个候选。
brief.en: Use each RFC triple to verify primality and distinct residues separately modulo 17 and 19. Each new modulus excludes at most one candidate.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖续批 · FR-8002 · 找到本身也为单位的模 30030 覆盖表
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage II · FR-8002 · Cover modulus 30030 with base candidates that are units

brief.zh: 逐项删除已覆盖的偶类。旧表含 3、5、7、11，这些素数的本类无法容纳三个素数提升。本表各基类均可继续提升。
brief.en: Remove the covered even classes in order. The previous table included 3,5,7,11, whose classes cannot contain three prime lifts. Each new base class can be lifted.

gaps.statement: let X := fun (p t : ℕ) => (p:ℝ)*(if p ∣ t then 1 else 0)-1; ∀ (N p q : ℕ), 0 < N → Nat.Prime p → Nat.Prime q → p ∣ N → q ∣ N → ((∑ t ∈ Finset.range N, X p t * X q t)/(N:ℝ)) = if p=q then (p:ℝ)-1 else 0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Liouville 相关的整除膨胀 · LD-8001 · 计算模 N 均匀测度下素因子整除指示的协方差
plain_statement.en: New route · Dilation of Liouville correlations · LD-8001 · Compute covariance of prime divisibility indicators modulo N

brief.zh: 统计 [0,N) 内的 p 倍数。异素数时，交集为 pq 的倍数，且 pq 整除 N。
brief.en: Count multiples of p in [0,N). For distinct primes the intersection consists of multiples of pq, which divides N.

gaps.statement: let L := fun n : ℕ => if n=0 then (0:ℝ) else (-1:ℝ)^n.primeFactorsList.length; let C := fun n : ℕ => (∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, L t * L (n-t))/(n:ℝ); ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → (∑ p ∈ N.divisors.filter Nat.Prime, (C (N/p)-C N)^2/((p:ℝ)-1)) ≤ ((N-1:ℕ):ℝ)/(N:ℝ)-(C N)^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Liouville 相关的整除膨胀 · LD-8003 · 给素因子整除膨胀的同时偏差一个方差预算
plain_statement.en: New route · Dilation of Liouville correlations · LD-8003 · Bound simultaneous prime-dilation deviations by the variance

brief.zh: 对 p·1_{p∣t}−1 使用 LD-8001 和 LD-8002。将平方范数展开，有限样本中 t=0 的贡献为零，其余为 1。
brief.en: Use LD-8001 and LD-8002 for the centered indicators. Expand the squared norm. The squared endpoint term is zero and every other squared term is one.

gaps.statement: let L := fun n : ℕ => if n=0 then (0:ℝ) else (-1:ℝ)^n.primeFactorsList.length; let C := fun n : ℕ => (∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, L t * L (n-t))/(n:ℝ); ∀ (N p : ℕ), 0 < N → Nat.Prime p → p ∣ N → (∑ t ∈ (Finset.range N).filter (fun t => p ∣ t), L t * L (N-t))/((N/p:ℕ):ℝ)=C (N/p)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Liouville 相关的整除膨胀 · LD-8002 · 计算整除纤维上 Liouville 二元相关的平均
plain_statement.en: New route · Dilation of Liouville correlations · LD-8002 · Compute the mean Liouville pair correlation on a divisibility fiber

brief.zh: 以 t=pu 换元。两个 Liouville 因子各乘 −1，端点按 L(0)=0 处理。
brief.en: Reindex t=pu. Each Liouville factor gains a minus sign. Handle the endpoint with L(0)=0.

gaps.statement: ∀ n d e : ℕ, 0 < d → 0 < e → ((∃ p : ℕ, p % d = n % d ∧ p % e = 1 % e) ↔ n % (Nat.gcd d e) = 1 % (Nat.gcd d e))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖 · FR-7012 · p−1 辅助权的广义 CRT
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage · FR-7012 · Generalized CRT for the p−1 probe

brief.zh: 先仅处理相容性，不把两个模数当成独立；之后按 lcm 进入分布估计。
brief.en: Establish compatibility before applying progression estimates modulo the lcm.

gaps.statement: ∀ (q a n : ℕ), 3 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → a < q → Nat.Coprime a q → 8000000000 ≤ n → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/(840 * Real.log (n:ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 把 BMOR 定理 1.1 的小模数 ψ 估计形式化
plain_statement.en: Formalize the small-modulus ψ bound of BMOR Theorem 1.1

brief.zh: 从定理 1.1 的式 (1.9)–(1.11) 取 q=3…105 的范围。保留 x≥8×10⁹ 和 1/840，核对端点包含在求和内。权威核验需要 Lean 证明及所用数值证书。
brief.en: Specialize (1.9)–(1.11) to 3 ≤ q ≤ 105. Retain the threshold and constant, reconcile the inclusive sum, and provide checked proofs for the analytic and numerical inputs.

gaps.statement: (∀ (q a n : ℕ), 3 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → a < q → Nat.Coprime a q → 8000000000 ≤ n → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/(840 * Real.log (n:ℝ))) → (∀ q n : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → 1 ≤ n → (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => ¬ Nat.Coprime k q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) ≤ (q.primeFactors.card:ℝ)*Real.log n) → (∀ (q a n : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → Nat.Coprime a q → 10^16 ≤ n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/100)

plain_statement.zh: 由 BMOR 的 ψ 界恢复 FR-7022 的全部模数
plain_statement.en: Recover the full FR-7022 modulus range from BMOR ψ

brief.zh: 模 4 的奇类补足 q=2；再用 FR-7023 控制偶数权重补足 q=1。其余模数直接换算误差。
brief.en: Add the two odd classes modulo four for q=2, then use FR-7023 on the even contribution for q=1. The other moduli use the explicit error directly.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 10^16 ≤ n → (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (if k.Prime then 0 else ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k)) ≤ (n:ℝ)/200

plain_statement.zh: 给所有高次素数幂一个显式的 n/200 总预算
plain_statement.en: Give all higher prime powers a global n/200 budget

brief.zh: 对 pᵏ≤n、k≥2，用已有底数上界 √n 和指数上界 log₂ n。于是总权重至多 √n·log₂(n)·log n；验证它从 10¹⁶ 起小于 n/200。可独立于等差数列完成。
brief.en: Use the base and exponent cutoffs for pᵏ ≤ n with k ≥ 2. Bound the total by √n log₂(n) log n and check the ratio from 10¹⁶ onward. No progression estimates are required.

gaps.statement: ∀ (q a n : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → Nat.Coprime a q → 10^16 ≤ n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), (if k.Prime then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k else 0)) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/200

plain_statement.zh: 只计素数，给等差数列的误差留出 n/200
plain_statement.en: Bound the prime-only progression error by n/200

brief.zh: 对素数有 Λ(p)=log p。BMOR 定理 1.2 控制 q≥3；q=2 用模 4 的两个奇剩余类，q=1 再加素数 2。保留阈值 10¹⁶。
brief.en: Use Λ(p)=log p and Theorem 1.2 for q ≥ 3. For q=2 combine both odd classes modulo four. For q=1 also include the prime two. Keep the explicit threshold.

gaps.statement: (∀ (q a n : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → Nat.Coprime a q → 10^16 ≤ n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), (if k.Prime then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k else 0)) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/200) → (∀ n : ℕ, 10^16 ≤ n → (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (if k.Prime then 0 else ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k)) ≤ (n:ℝ)/200) → (∀ (q a n : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → Nat.Coprime a q → 10^16 ≤ n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/100)

plain_statement.zh: 合并素数与高次幂的两个半预算，推出 FR-7022
plain_statement.en: Combine the prime and higher-power budgets for FR-7022

brief.zh: 一个剩余类内的非素数权重非负且至多为全局总量。把两个 n/200 相加，得到原声明要求的 n/100。
brief.en: The nonprime weight in each class is nonnegative and bounded by the global sum. Adding the two n/200 budgets gives the original n/100.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let μ := fun d : ℕ => ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ); let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; ∀ (n U L R : ℕ) (t : ℝ), let M := fun a : ℕ => ∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors a).filter (fun d => U < d), μ d; let T := fun m : ℕ => ∑ a ∈ (Nat.divisors m).filter (fun a => L < a ∧ a ≤ R ∧ U < m/a), M a * Λ (m/a); (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (T m : ℂ) * E ((m:ℝ)*t)) = ∑ a ∈ Finset.Ioc L (min R n), ∑ b ∈ Finset.Ioc U (n/a), ((M a * Λ b : ℝ):ℂ) * E ((a*b:ℕ)*t)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 有符号因子与移位窗 · FW-8001 · 把 Vaughan 带谱展开为带乘积截断的双和
plain_statement.en: New route · Signed factors and shift windows · FW-8001 · Unfold a Vaughan band into a product-truncated double sum

brief.zh: 用 m=ab 双射，分别处理 m=0 和下降的区间。L、R 可取前三带的真实整数端点。供六个双线性格共用。
brief.en: Use m=ab and the exact floors, including m=0 and empty intervals. Substituting the first three bands serves all six core cells.

gaps.statement: ∀ (a b N r₀ s₀ g i j : ℤ), 0 < g → g ∣ a → g ∣ b → a*r₀+b*s₀=N → (r₀+(b/g)*i)*(s₀-(a/g)*j)-(r₀+(b/g)*j)*(s₀-(a/g)*i)=-(N/g)*(j-i)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 有符号因子与移位窗 · FW-8007 · 计算反射纤维的两点行列式
plain_statement.en: New route · Signed factors and shift windows · FW-8007 · Compute the determinant of two points on a reflected fiber

brief.zh: 先还原整除下的约化步长，再展开。远非对角项的行列式随目标增长。
brief.en: Use exact division of the steps and expand. The determinant off the diagonal grows with the target.

gaps.statement: ∀ (a b N r₀ s₀ : ℤ), 0 < a → 0 < b → a*r₀+b*s₀=N → let g := (Int.gcd a b : ℤ); ∀ r s : ℤ, a*r+b*s=N ↔ ∃ j : ℤ, r=r₀+(b/g)*j ∧ s=s₀-(a/g)*j

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 有符号因子与移位窗 · FW-8006 · 参数化固定因子线上的整数解
plain_statement.en: New route · Signed factors and shift windows · FW-8006 · Parametrize the integer solutions on a factor line

brief.zh: 除以公因子后使用约化步长互素。证明所有整点恰落在这个参数族内，再将带限交给参数区间。
brief.en: Divide by the gcd and use coprimality of the reduced steps. Prove both directions for all integers before imposing band limits.

gaps.statement: ∀ (J : Finset ℤ) (D : ℕ) (u v : ℤ → ℝ) (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B → (∀ i ∈ J, |u i * v i| ≤ B) → |∑ i ∈ J, ∑ j ∈ J.filter (fun j => j ≠ i ∧ (j-i).natAbs ≤ D), u i * v i * (u j * v j)| ≤ (J.card:ℝ) * (2*(D:ℝ)) * B^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 有符号因子与移位窗 · FW-8008 · 给有限纤维上近对角能量单列上界
plain_statement.en: New route · Signed factors and shift windows · FW-8008 · Bound the near-diagonal energy of a finite fiber

brief.zh: 固定 i 后注入长度 2D 的双侧非零移位集，再用绝对值和与权上界。全局预算还须乘上每类纤维的实际数量。
brief.en: For each i, inject the adjacent indices into the 2D nonzero offsets. Apply the absolute weight bound. The global budget also needs the number of fibers in each range.

gaps.statement: let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; ∀ (n a b U : ℕ), 0 < a → 0 < b → let g := Nat.gcd a b; (∑ r ∈ Finset.Ioc U (n/a), ∑ s ∈ (Finset.Ioc U (n/b)).filter (fun s => a*r+b*s=n), Λ r * Λ s) = if g ∣ n then ∑ r ∈ (Finset.Ioc U (n/a)).filter (fun r => (a/g)*r % (b/g) = (n/g) % (b/g) ∧ U < (n-a*r)/b), Λ r * Λ ((n-a*r)/b) else 0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 有符号因子与移位窗 · FW-8002 · 把固定因子线的 Mangoldt 对限制到约化同余类
plain_statement.en: New route · Signed factors and shift windows · FW-8002 · Restrict the Mangoldt pair on each factor line to a reduced congruence

brief.zh: 固定 a,b；g 不整除目标时直线为空。否则先除 g 再取余，整除和 a r≤n 同时保证第二余因子的取值与端点。对应全圆对角；深弧还须扣宽弧。
brief.en: Fix a,b. Divide by the gcd before taking the congruence. Divisibility and ar≤n determine the other cofactor and its endpoints. This treats the full-circle diagonal. The wide-arc subtraction remains.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let deepCoeff := fun (n m : ℕ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (wideArcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => (S n w u)^2 * E (-(m:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ n H : ℕ, Even n → 0 < H → 2*(H-1) ≤ n → (∑ j ∈ Finset.range H, deepCoeff n (n+2*j))/(H:ℂ) = intervalIntegral (fun t => (wideArcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => f n u * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range H, E (-2*(j:ℝ)*u))/(H:ℂ))) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 有符号因子与移位窗 · FW-8004 · 求冻结深弧上归一化偶移平均的频率响应
plain_statement.en: New route · Signed factors and shift windows · FW-8004 · Identify the frequency response of the frozen even-shift average

brief.zh: 先固定 n 的权和遮罩，再交换有限和与积分。使用既有几何核界控制远离半整数的部分；距离指定点的单侧损失另计。
brief.en: Keep the weights and mask at n before interchanging the sum and integral. The existing kernel bounds frequencies away from half-integers. A separate one-sided loss remains at n.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 有符号因子与移位窗 · FW-8003 · 算出归一化偶移核的最短有效支撑
plain_statement.en: New route · Signed factors and shift windows · FW-8003 · Lower-bound the support of a normalized even-shift kernel

brief.zh: 对和为一的窗用 Cauchy–Schwarz，插入原预算。该长度排除了极短平滑窗；仍需推回指定 n。
brief.en: Apply Cauchy–Schwarz to the unit mass and insert the frozen energy budget. This excludes short windows. Transfer to n is a separate estimate.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; let μ := fun d : ℕ => ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ); let U := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/16:ℝ)⌋₊; let B₂ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let B₃ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let τ₃ := fun (n m : ℕ) => ∑ a ∈ (Nat.divisors m).filter (fun a => B₂ n < a ∧ a ≤ B₃ n ∧ U n < m / a), (∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors a).filter (fun d => U n < d), μ d) * Λ (m / a); let Jdeep := fun (n : ℕ) (u v : ℕ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (wideArcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun x => S n u x * S n v x * E (-(n:ℝ)*x)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ n : ℕ, let f := fun t : ℝ => (S n (τ₃ n) t)^2 * E (-(n:ℝ)*t); Jdeep n (τ₃ n) (τ₃ n) = ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), τ₃ n k * τ₃ n (n-k)):ℝ) - intervalIntegral ((wideArcs n).indicator f) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 有符号因子与移位窗 · FW-8005 · 用真实第三带权把深弧系数写成全圆系数减宽弧系数
plain_statement.en: New route · Signed factors and shift windows · FW-8005 · Subtract the wide arcs from the full-circle coefficient for band three

brief.zh: 先用整数频率正交求全圆系数。用有限个可测有理弧分去宽弧。保留冻结声明的截断和复数值，供比较 GSP 的中央窗和乘积截断。
brief.en: Use orthogonality of integer frequencies on the full interval. Subtract the finite union of measurable wide arcs. Keep the frozen cutoffs and complex value when comparing with GSP.

title.zh: Theta 提升与素数反射

description.zh: 固定测试向量，比较正负反射范数；核心缺口是同一归一化下的算术匹配与严格间隔。 建议从中心卷积一阶矩、上界筛或局部因子二阶均值开始；这些中间结果允许剩余例外。
description.en: Fix both test vectors and compare their norms with one normalization. Arithmetic matching and strict separation remain open. Start with the central first moment, the sieve envelope or the local second moment; these allow exceptional targets.

title.zh: 奇特征零点干涉

description.zh: 固定偶模数，保留相位、重数和原平均分母；目标是截断交叉项的逐点单侧裕量。
description.en: Keep phases, multiplicities and the original denominator. Seek a one-sided margin at each even modulus.

title.zh: 把素数对变成可估计的量
title.en: From prime pairs to a weighted sum

description.zh: 为傅里叶系数提取和换权误差提供有限卷积恒等式。
description.en: Finite convolution identities for coefficient extraction and changes of weight.

title.zh: 剔除真素数幂

description.zh: 将 Λ 卷积换回只含素数的卷积，并定量控制误差。
description.en: Convert the Mangoldt correlation to primes and bound the correction.

title.zh: 计算每个模数的局部障碍

description.zh: 给奇异级数提供可证明的局部因子，从素模数推广到合数。
description.en: Supply local factors for the singular series, from primes through composite moduli.

title.zh: 给局部修正乘积建立下界

description.zh: 把有限局部计数归一化，控制乘积截断，以便估计主弧主项。
description.en: Normalize local counts and control truncated products for the major-arc main term.

title.zh: 建立有限傅里叶变换

description.zh: 在有限循环群上验证正交性、反演与能量公式，为检查圆法系数提供独立模型。
description.en: Use character orthogonality, inversion and energy on a finite cyclic group as an independent coefficient model.

title.zh: 提取圆法积分系数

description.zh: 逐项验证单位圆、截断权和主次弧分割的积分操作。
description.en: Verify integration on the unit interval, truncated weights, and the partition into arcs.

title.zh: 从同余类到主弧指数和

description.zh: 先组织剩余类上的 Λ 质量，再通过分部求和传递误差。若采用 GRH，各结论保留该假设。
description.en: Organize Mangoldt mass by residue and transport errors by partial summation. Keep GRH explicit where used.

title.zh: 计算有理频率的主项

description.zh: 从单位根和与几何核出发，建立主弧近似的可计算模型。
description.en: Combine unit-root sums with the geometric kernel to model the main arcs.

title.zh: 主弧下界与次弧抵消

description.zh: 两条攻关任务采用同一套弧宽、权和阈值定义。两项估计若都成立，可得到充分大偶数的结论，阈值以下仍需另证。
description.en: Both research targets use the same arcs and weights. Together they would cover sufficiently large evens. Values below the resulting threshold require a separate proof.

title.zh: 估计例外集合并识别平均界的局限
title.en: Control exceptional sets and track what averages imply

description.zh: 这些任务可给出几乎处处的结果。要排除最后一个例外，还需要逐点输入或把整数计数严格压到一以下。
description.en: These estimates can give almost-all results. Eliminating the last exception needs pointwise information or an exceptional count strictly below one.

title.zh: 临界带与反射零点

description.zh: 对照 prim_reflect 和 strip；把所需的零点条件写在前提中。
description.en: Trace prim_reflect and strip; keep the zero-location input explicit.

title.zh: 带重数的截断零点和

description.zh: 以有限指标记录重数；从 LFunction_eq_zero_re 只取实部信息，再处理各块系数。
description.en: Index multiplicities separately; extract real parts from LFunction_eq_zero_re and estimate the coefficients.

title.zh: 从本原特征转回原模数
title.en: Euler-factor losses under change of modulus

description.zh: 从 prim_zero 的有限欧拉因子出发，区分单个因子的非消失、有限乘积的误差与总预算。
description.en: Follow prim_zero; separate nonvanishing, product stability and the total cost.

title.zh: 把剩余类的估计合并成频率估计
title.en: From residue-class errors to frequency bounds

description.zh: 借鉴 everyCharacter_of_row 逐块归并；保持模数、权函数与频率统一。
description.en: Use the block assembly in everyCharacter_of_row; keep the modulus, weight and frequency fixed.

title.zh: 把区间误差转成平滑权误差
title.en: Transfer interval bounds to smooth weights

description.zh: 先控制权的离散差分，再用已知的前缀和误差做分部求和。
description.en: Bound discrete variation before summation by parts against prefix discrepancies.

title.zh: 将单侧素数误差传给二元卷积
title.en: Propagate one-variable errors into binary convolution

description.zh: 固定同一个目标偶数；在有限反射卷积内展开两个输入，保留交叉项的符号。
description.en: Keep the target fixed, expand both inputs in the reflected convolution, and track the cross term.

title.zh: 从 GRH 分布估计到区间主项
title.en: GRH progression estimates on moving windows

description.zh: 先核对上游任意模数的零点命题，再从本项目 grh-progression-error 的单端点界推导；保留 GRH 前提。
description.en: Check the upstream all-moduli zero statement and derive from the project's grh-progression-error endpoint bound. Keep GRH explicit.

title.zh: 中央表示的支撑、重数和逐点缺口
title.en: Central support, multiplicity and pointwise gaps

description.zh: 在中央窗口做集合计数；将密度输入同真正的逐点配对输入分开。
description.en: Count candidates on the central window. Distinguish marginal density from a pointwise overlap bound.

title.zh: 从单变量主弧逼近到二元系数误差
title.en: Propagate major-arc approximation into the binary coefficient

description.zh: 沿用有理频率附近的 Λ 指数和估计，量化平方、积分和多个弧段累加的损失。最后仍须单独证明逐点次弧下界。
description.en: Start with the Mangoldt estimate near a rational frequency. Track the cost of squaring and integrating across arcs; pointwise minor-arc cancellation remains open.

title.zh: 为主弧模型建立模数系数表

description.zh: 调用一般 Ramanujan 和，再核对 Möbius 值与单位类数；频率分子保持任意互素。
description.en: Apply the Ramanujan sum identity and certify the totient and Möbius coefficient.

title.zh: 次弧：先剔除立方根以下的素数
title.en: Minor arcs after removing small primes

description.zh: 保持原题的弧和频率；先用低段长度与 Parseval 控制低低、低高项，再单独攻高高项的有符号下界。
description.en: Keep the original arcs and frequency. Use the short support and Parseval on the small terms, then study the signed bulk.

title.zh: 前沿一：中弧 Siegel/Gallagher/BV 模数带子猜想
title.en: Frontier 1: Medium-arc Siegel, Gallagher, and BV modulus-band sub-conjectures

description.zh: 将主弧补集分为中弧核、中弧裙边与深次弧，无条件证明 Ramanujan-Fejér 模型非负性，并将中弧按模数尺度精细拆分为 Siegel 准多项式带、Gallagher 无对数零点密度带与 Bombieri-Vinogradov 越界带五个开放子猜想。
description.en: Partition minor arcs into medium core, skirt, and deep zones; prove unconditional Fejér model positivity; and split medium-arc approximation into 5 open sub-conjectures across Siegel, Gallagher, and BV modulus bands.

title.zh: 前沿二：深次弧 Vaughan 双线性 Type-II 十格点猜想矩阵
title.en: Frontier 2: Ten-cell dyadic Type-II × Type-II bilinear conjecture matrix

description.zh: 在深次弧上先无条件完成 L² Parseval 换权并消去所有初段与 Type-I 交叉项，将未知核心压缩为四段 Type-II 二分带交织出的十个双线性元胞，精准分离可攻克角格点与真正的奇偶性核心 (n^(1/3), n^(2/3)]。
description.en: Unconditionally swap to Λ and eliminate all Type-I terms on deep minor arcs, compressing the open core to 10 dyadic Type-II × Type-II cells that isolate the parity core (n^(1/3), n^(2/3)].

title.zh: 前沿三：四阶矩、3/4 幂 saving 与反尖峰平滑传递猜想
title.en: Frontier 3: Fourth-moment, 3/4 power-saving, and anti-spike transfer conjectures

description.zh: 深次弧四阶矩上界收到反证（#2508），暂停该题的正向领取，等待 Lean 对冻结声明的否定进行核验。3/4 逐点估计与二阶矩—反尖峰传递仍分别开放。
description.en: A refutation of the deep fourth-moment bound is under review (#2508). Positive claims on that task are paused pending kernel verification. The three-quarters estimate and second-moment/anti-spike transfer remain open.

title.zh: 前沿四：GRH 压缩等价链、无 Siegel 零点与 3/5-BV 水平
title.en: Frontier 4: GRH equivalence chain, no Siegel zeros, and 3/5-BV level

description.zh: 用 GRH 将中弧彻底消去并把深次弧的开放困难隔离出来，同时独立刻画排除 Siegel 零点、水平 3/5 的 Bombieri-Vinogradov 分布与扩展至 √n 尺度的次弧带等经典前沿猜想。
description.en: Use GRH to clear the medium zones and isolate deepMinor, while formalizing classic frontier conjectures on Siegel zeros, level-3/5 BV distribution, and √n-scale arcs.

title.zh: 前沿五：物理空间素数关联与 Ramanujan-sinc 核子猜想
title.en: Frontier 5: Spatial prime correlation and Ramanujan-sinc kernel sub-conjectures

description.zh: 完全脱离指数和平方估计，将次弧积分精确拆解为对角主项与低模近带、低模远带、高模带三个空间 Ramanujan-sinc 卷积和，提供纯物理空间攻关接口。
description.en: Bypass exponential-sum squaring by splitting the minor-arc integral into the diagonal prime-pair term minus three explicit spatial Ramanujan-sinc regimes.

title.zh: 特征与分母扩窗

description.zh: 在有限特征和与实际弧带上核验例外项、模数扩窗和均方预算。
description.en: Compute exceptional character terms, arc extensions and mean-square budgets with the actual denominators and masks.

title.zh: 深次弧四次矩反驳

description.zh: 用独立 ID 提交旧上界的严格否定。
description.en: Submit a proof of the exact negation of the retired upper bound under a distinct ID.

title.zh: 裙边与显式算术输入

description.zh: 隔离第四带自由变量、小分母裙边核及显式等差数列常数。
description.en: Isolate the free variable in band four, the small-modulus skirt kernel and explicit progression constants.

title.zh: 小偶数覆盖续批

description.zh: 在计算边界外核验真素数对，提升粗数轮模，并精确计数陈氏候选中的平方余项。
description.en: Verify prime pairs above the computation boundary, lift the rough-number wheel and count square remainders among Chen candidates.

title.zh: Liouville 相关的整除膨胀

description.zh: 对固定目标量化素因子整除条件下的二元 Liouville 相关。一般偶数的符号和与真素数对的联系仍开放。
description.en: Quantify two-point Liouville correlation under prime divisibility at a fixed target. Its sign for general even targets and its relation to prime pairs remain open.

title.zh: 有符号因子与移位窗

description.zh: 展开真实双线性权，比较冻结深弧遮罩上的偶移平均与指定系数。
description.en: Unfold the arithmetic bilinear weights and compare even-shift averages with the prescribed coefficient under a fixed deep-arc mask.
